detailed.name: articular membrane of the protibio-probasitarsal joint
detailed.def: The articular membrane that is located in the protibio-probasitarsal joint.

detailed.translation: 前足胫节-基跗节关节膜
detailed.phonetic: /ɑːrˈtɪkjʊlər ˈmɛmbreɪn ɒv ðə ˌprəʊˈtɪbiəʊ ˌprəʊbeɪsɪˈtɑːrsəl dʒɔɪnt/

detailed.name: articular notch
detailed.def: The notch at the base of the lateral coxal condyle of the metapleuron.

relationships.target_name: lateral coxal condyle of the metapleuron

detailed.name: articular process
detailed.def: The projection that bears the articular surface.

detailed.name: articular surface
detailed.def: The area that is located on the sclerite and that makes movable direct contact with another sclerite.

detailed.name: articulation
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of two adjacent articular surfaces.

detailed.name: asexual organism
detailed.def: Multi-cellular organism that does not produce gametes.

detailed.name: atrium
detailed.def: The cuticular invagination that is sclerotized and is between the external aperture of the spiracle and the distal end of the trachea.

detailed.name: atypical epithelium
detailed.def: Epithelium that consists of epithelial cells not arranged in one ore more layers.

detailed.name: aulax
detailed.def: The impression that is on the first valvifer-first valvula complex accommodates the rhachis.

relationships.target_name: dorsal ramus of the first valvula

detailed.name: auricle
detailed.def: The area that is located laterally (dorsally, externally) on the proximal margin of the metabasitarsus and accommodates the rastellum.

detailed.name: auxiliar sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located between the unguitractor and the bases of claws.

detailed.name: auxiliary propodeal carina
detailed.def: The carina that connects the posterior margin of the metapleuron with the lateral propodeal carina.

detailed.translation: (并胸腹节辅助脊)|(并胸腹节副脊)

detailed.name: axilla
detailed.def: The area that is located posterior to the transscutal articulation and anterior to the scutoscutellar suture.

detailed.name: axillar carina
detailed.def: The line that separates the dorsal and lateral axillar surfaces.

detailed.name: axillar crescent
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster composed of the transaxillar carina, axillar carina, and axillular carina.

detailed.name: axillar depression
detailed.def: The area that is located lateral to the mesoscutellar disc and is delimited posterolaterally by the mesoscutellar arm and anterolaterally by the scutoscutellar sulcus.

detailed.name: axillar phragma
detailed.def: The apodeme that is located submedially on the anterior part of dorsal axillar surface and corresponds to the site of origin of the anterior mesonoto-mesotrochanteral muscle.

detailed.name: axillary cord
detailed.def: The area that is heavily sclerotized and located proximally on the posterior wing margin.

detailed.name: axillary cord of the fore wing
detailed.def: The axillary cord that is located on the fore wing.

detailed.name: axillary cord of the hind wing
detailed.def: The axillary cord that is located on the hind wing.

detailed.name: axillary muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that is attached to the axillary sclerite.

detailed.name: axillary region
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the axillary sclerites.

detailed.name: axillary sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the axillary region and articulates with one of the thoracic wing processes.

detailed.name: axillary region of the fore wing
detailed.def: The axillary region that is located on the fore wing base.

detailed.translation: 腋侧片; 小盾片侧区

detailed.name: axillula
detailed.def: The area that is located laterally on the mesoscutellum and is limited anteriorly by the scutoscutellar suture and medially by the axillular line.

detailed.name: axillular carina
detailed.def: The axillular line that is a carina.

detailed.translation: 腋侧片脊|(小盾片侧区隆线)

detailed.name: axillular groove
detailed.def: The axillular line that is an impression.

detailed.name: axillular line
detailed.def: The line that is sublateral, and extends between the medial end of the mesoscutellar arm and the scutoscutellar suture.

detailed.name: axillular setae
detailed.def: The row of setae that extends along the median margin of axillula.

detailed.translation: 腋侧片刚毛列|(小盾片侧区刚毛列)

detailed.name: axillular spine
detailed.def: The spine on the distal margin of the axillula.

detailed.translation: 腋侧片端刺|(小盾片侧区端刺)

detailed.name: band
detailed.def: The area that is oblong and differs from surrounding areas in coloration, surface sculpture and setae.

detailed.name: banding pattern
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the strongly sclerotised areas corresponding with the annuli and less strongly sclerotised areas situated between them.

detailed.name: bar
detailed.def: The process that is linear and wider proximally than distally.

detailed.name: basal articulation
detailed.def: The articulation that is part of the second valvifer-second valvula-third valvula complex and adjacent to the rhachis.

detailed.name: basal bridge
detailed.def: The area that connects the parosicculi.

synonyms.name: sclerotic bridge uniting bases of volsellae

detailed.name: basal cardinal ridge
detailed.def: The cardinal ridge that is median.

detailed.name: basal galeal sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that receives the site of insertion of the stipito-galeal muscle.

detailed.name: basal glossal invagination
detailed.def: The anterior invagination of the labium that is adjacent with the distal end of the salivarium and separates the glossa proximally from the distal hypopharynx and the paraglossae.

detailed.name: basal grooves
detailed.def: The row of impressions that extends along the anterior margin of an abdominal tergum or a sternum.

detailed.name: basal hooklet
detailed.def: The projection that is located along the medial margin of the parossiculus.

detailed.name: basal knob
detailed.def: The fossa that accommodates the antennal condyle of the cranium.

detailed.name: basal lacinial sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is on the medial stipital wall, connected to the lacinial lobe and receives the site of insertion of the stipito-lacinial muscle.

detailed.translation: (基叶节骨片)|(茎节内壁基叶骨片)

detailed.name: basal lamina
detailed.def: Acellular anatomical structure that consists of a thin sheet of fibrous proteins that underlie and support the cells of an epithelium. It separates the cells of an epithelium from any underlying tissue.

detailed.name: basal line of the second valvifer
detailed.def: The line on the second valvifer that extends between the pars articularis and the dorsal flange of second valvifer.

detailed.name: basal longitudinal carinae of the syntergum
detailed.def: The anteroposteriorly oriented carinae that arise posteriorly from the transverse carina on petiole.

detailed.name: basal node
detailed.def: The projection that is located proximally on the external surface of the mandible distomedially of the mandibular condyle.

detailed.name: basal process of the prementum
detailed.def: The articular process that bears the postmental articular surface of the prementum.

detailed.name: basal tooth of mandible
detailed.def: The projection that is located proximally on the anterior edge of the mandible.

detailed.name: basal transverse carina of third abdominal tergite
detailed.def: The carina that extends along the proximal margin of the third abdominal tergite.

detailed.phonetic: /ˈbeɪsəl trænzˈvɜːs kəˈraɪnə əv θɜːd æbˈdɒmɪnl ˈtɜːdʒaɪt/

detailed.name: basal vein
detailed.def: The wing vein that is basally located on the fore wing and connects or nearly connects the submarginal vein and the medial plus cubital veins.

detailed.name: basalar apodeme
detailed.def: The cup-shaped, sclerotised region et the apical portion of the tendon of the basalare that serves as the site of origin of the basalare muscles.

detailed.translation: (基翅骨片内突)|(基翅骨片肌腱杯状骨化区)

detailed.name: basalare
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the dorsal margin of the pectus of pterothoracic segment anteriorly of the pleural wing articulation.

detailed.name: basicosta
detailed.def: The ridge that is located proximally and submarginally in the coxa.

detailed.translation: 基内脊|(基节近端亚缘脊)

detailed.name: basicostal suture
detailed.def: The sulcus that corresponds to the basicosta.

detailed.name: basicoxite
detailed.def: The area that is located on the coxa proximal to the basicostal suture.

detailed.name: basiparaglossa
detailed.def: The proximal area of the paraglossa that is adjacent to the basiparaglossal brush.

detailed.name: basiparaglossal brush
detailed.def: The anteroproximal area of the paraglossa that is covered with long acanthae and corresponds to the ligament connecting the hypopharyngeal button with the basiparaglossal sclerite.

detailed.name: basiparaglossal sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located medially on the paraglossa and articulates with the anterior glossal plate and is continuous with the hypopharyngeal rod..

detailed.name: basisternum
detailed.def: The area that is located anteriorly of the site of origin of the furca.

detailed.name: basistipital process
detailed.def: The articular porcess that bears the cardinal condyle of the stipes and receives the site of attachment of the tentorio-cardinal muscle.

detailed.name: basitarsal articular process of the mesotibia
detailed.def: The articular process that is located distodorsally on the mesotibia and bears the basitarsal fossa of the protiba.

detailed.name: basitarsal articular process of the metatibia
detailed.def: The articular process that is located anteriorly on the distal margin of the metatibia and bears the basitarsal articular fossa of the metatibia.

detailed.name: basitarsal articular process of the protibia
detailed.def: The articular process that is located distodorsally on the protibia and bears the basitarsal fossa of the protiba.

detailed.name: basitarsal comb
detailed.def: The row of setae that extends along the ventral margin of the probasitarsus.

detailed.translation: 基跗节栉|(基跗节腹缘毛列)

detailed.name: basitarsal fossa of the mesotibia
detailed.def: The fossa that is located on the basitarsal articular process of the mesotibia and accommodates the tibial condyle of the mesobasitarsus.

relationships.target_name: basitarsal articular process of the mesotibia

detailed.name: basitarsal fossa of the metatibia
detailed.def: The fossa that is located on the basitarsal articular process of the metatibia and accommodates the tibial condyle of the metabasitarsus.

detailed.name: basitarsal fossa of the protibia
detailed.def: The fossa that is located on the basitarsal articular process of the protibia and accommodate the tibial condyle of the probasitarsus.

detailed.name: basitarsal notch
detailed.def: The notch that is located proximally on the median surface of the probasitarsus.

detailed.name: basitarsus
detailed.def: The tarsomere that is the proximal most annulus of the tarsus, connected proximally with the tibia and distally with the second tarsomere via membranous conjunctivae.

detailed.name: basiura
detailed.def: The area that is the proximal part of the gonossiculus and corresponds to the site of insertion of medial penisvalvo-gonossiculal muscle.

detailed.name: basivalvula
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of small sclerites and is located proximally on the first valvulae.

detailed.name: blade
detailed.def: The area that is located distally on the mandible.

detailed.name: body
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the whole organism but which excludes the antennae, legs and wings.

detailed.name: body length
detailed.def: The anatomical line between the anteriormost pont of the cranium and the posteriormost point of the metasoma.

detailed.name: body segment
detailed.def: The segment that is the part of the body.

detailed.name: buccal lobe
detailed.def: The area of the epipharyngeal wall that is posterior to the epipharyngeal lobe, is thicker than surrounding regions of the epipharyngeal wall and is covered with dorsally oriented acanthae.

detailed.name: bulb
detailed.def: The anterior area of the dorsal valve that is bulbous.

relationships.target_name: dorsal ramus of the second valvula

detailed.name: bulla
detailed.def: The anatomical region of the wing vein that is less melanized and more flexible than surrounding anatomical wing vein regions and corresponds to the intersection of the wing vein with a flexion line.

detailed.name: bulla of the Waterston's evaporatorium
detailed.def: The smooth, median area on the anterior part of the Waterston's evaportatorium posterior to the antecosta.

detailed.name: calyptra
detailed.def: The flange that is located just laterally of the first abdominal spiracle.

detailed.translation: (第一腹节气门侧突缘)|(气门盖片)

detailed.name: calyx
detailed.def: The broadened portion of the lateral oviduct is enlarged and contains virus particles (characterized by bluish autofluorescence).

detailed.name: callus
detailed.def: The area that is located laterally of the propodeal spiracle and is delimited anterolaterally by the metapleural sulcus.

detailed.name: campaniform sensillum
detailed.def: The aporous sensillum with a flat or dome-shaped, circular cuticular component that is delimited by a shallow depression.

detailed.name: campaniform sensillum of the glossa
detailed.def: The campaniform sensillum of the anterior surface of the glossa that is located proximal to the glossal annuli.

detailed.name: campaniform sensillum of the premenum
detailed.def: The campaniform sensillum that is on the ventral premental face.

detailed.name: campaniform stipital sensillum
detailed.def: The campaniform sensillum on the stipes.

detailed.name: cardinal articular condyle of the cranium
detailed.def: The condyle that is located on the cranium and articulates with the cranial fossa of the cardo.

detailed.translation: 头壳轴节关节髁|(头壳基节窝关节突)

detailed.name: capitate peg sensillum
detailed.def: Mushroom-shaped sensory structure on the flagellum, particularly theclava; sometimes called the sensilla ampullacea.

detailed.translation: 头状钉型感器|(蘑菇状感器)

detailed.name: cardinal condyle of lorum
detailed.def: The condyle that is located on the lorum and articulates with the loral fossa of the cardo.

detailed.name: cardinal condyle of the stipes
detailed.def: The condyle that articulates with the stipital fossa of the cardo.

detailed.name: cardinal fragmentum
detailed.def: The sclerite that is elongate, paired, is lateral to the cardo and is articulated with the cardo and with the stipes.

detailed.name: cardinal lever
detailed.def: The process that receives the site of attachment of the cranio-cardinal muscle.

detailed.name: cardinal macula
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is located on the distal cardinal cavity.

detailed.name: cardinal ridge
detailed.def: The carina that is on the cardo.

detailed.name: cardino-stipital hinge
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that is between the stipes and cardo.

detailed.name: cardo
detailed.def: The sclerite that is articulated with the cranium at the cranio-cardinal articulation, is connected to the stipes distolaterally via the stipitocardinal hinge and receives the site of attachment of the occipito-cardinal muscle.

detailed.name: carina
detailed.def: The process that is elongate and external.

detailed.name: carina mandibularis
detailed.def: The edge that separates the external and insternal surfaces of the mandible.

detailed.name: caudal cylinder
detailed.def: The petiolar area posterior to the posterior petiolar constriction.

detailed.name: caudal petiolar profile
detailed.def: The area of the petiolar node that is posterodorsal, oriented posterodorsally and is delimited anteriorly by a dorsally or anterodorsally oriented area.

detailed.name: caudal setal row on T7
detailed.def: The transverse row of setae on the posterior region of abdominal T7.

detailed.name: cavitated compound organ
detailed.def: Compound organ that contains one or more macroscopic anatomical spaces.

detailed.name: cell
detailed.def: Anatomical structure that has as its parts a maximally connected cell compartment surrounded by a plasma membrane.

detailed.name: cell component
detailed.def: Anatomical structure that is a direct part of the cell.

detailed.name: cell space
detailed.def: Anatomical space that is part of a cell.

detailed.name: cenchrus
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that is folded and located on the anterior margin of the metanotum and covered (at least partially) with setae.

detailed.name: central keel
detailed.def: The frontal line that is a carina.

detailed.name: central nervous system
detailed.def: Collective name for all the nerve centers and their connective in the insect's body. In the context of Drosophila refers to the part of the nervous system consisting of the brain and ventral ganglia.

detailed.name: cercal bristle
detailed.comment: This class is equivalent with HAO:2031 (mx:9848)

detailed.name: cercal plate
detailed.def: The sclerite that is one of a pair of sclerites located apically on the abdomen and bears the cercus.

detailed.name: cercal seta
detailed.def: The seta that is on the cercus.

detailed.name: cercus
detailed.def: The sense organ that located apicolaterally on one of the apicalmost abdominal terga and attaches to a large nerve cord.

detailed.name: cervical apodeme
detailed.def: The apodeme that is located posteriorly of and continuous with the cervical prominence and corresponds to the site of insertion of laterocervical muscles.

detailed.name: cervical prominence
detailed.def: The articular process that is located on the anterior margin of the propleuron and bears the cranial condyle of the propleuron.

detailed.name: cervical pronotal area
detailed.def: The area that is located medially on the pronotum and is delimited laterally by the epomial carina.

detailed.name: cervical sclerite
detailed.comment: There is no cervical sclerite and hence cervix in Hymenoptera (cervical prominence is not an independent sclerite)

detailed.name: cervix
detailed.comment: There are no cervical sclerites in Hymenoptera.

detailed.name: chaetobothria
detailed.def: The row of stout spines that is located along the anterior edge of the protibia.

detailed.name: chalaza
detailed.def: The seta that is located on a process.

detailed.name: chamber of the metanotum
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is delimited dorsally by the wall of the metascutellum, anteriorly and posteriorly by the bifurcated internal metanotal ridge.

detailed.name: cheek
detailed.def: The area that is located ventrally in between the eye and the oral foramen.

detailed.name: chela
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is formed from the tarsal claw and the apical tarsomere, and is grasping in function.

detailed.name: chorion
detailed.def: A hard shell external to the vitelline membrane of the egg.

detailed.name: cibarium
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is the anteriormost part of the alimentary canal and is delimited proximally by the proximomedian margin of the sitophore and distally by the functional mouth.

detailed.name: circulatory system
detailed.def: The anatomical system that is involved in circulation.

detailed.name: circumantennal carinae
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of concentric carinae that encircle the antennal foramen.

detailed.translation: 围触角窝隆线|(触角孔周脊)

detailed.name: circumocular ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that extends along the margin of the compound eye and corresponds to the ocular suture.

detailed.name: circumscutellar carina
detailed.def: The carina that encompasses a horizontal, median, rounded area of the mesoscutellar disc.

detailed.translation: 小盾片周缘脊|(小盾片周缘隆线)

detailed.name: clava
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster composed of the apical flagellomeres that are differentiated by size from the basal flagellomeres.

detailed.name: claval fold
detailed.def: The wing fold that is located on the fore wing, parallels the anal vein, and extends to the claval notch on the wing margin.

detailed.name: claval lobe
detailed.def: The wing region that is posterior to the claval furrow and anterior to the jugal fold.

detailed.name: clavomere
detailed.def: The flagellomere that is located in the clava.

detailed.name: cleaning brush
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is used to clean anatomical structures.

detailed.translation: 封闭基节臼|(基节窝封闭)

detailed.name: clypeal carina
detailed.def: The carina that is longitudinal and is located on the clypeus.

detailed.name: clypeal process
detailed.def: The process that is located medially on the clypeus.

detailed.name: clypeal tooth
detailed.def: The projection that is located on the distal margin of the clypeus.

detailed.name: clypeo-compound eye distance
detailed.def: The distance that is the shortest between the compound eye and the anterior tentorial pit and the compound eye.

detailed.name: clypeo-pleurostomal line
detailed.def: The line that extends from the anterior tentorial pit to the cranial margin and separates the clypeus laterally from the pleurostoma.

detailed.translation: 唇基侧口缘线|(唇基-侧口缘线)

detailed.name: clypeogenal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that corresponds to the clypeo-pleurostomal line.

detailed.translation: 唇基颊沟|(唇基-口侧线沟)

detailed.name: clypeus
detailed.def: The area that corresponds to the site of origin of the clypeo-epipharyngeal muscle.

detailed.name: clypeus-torulus distance
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is the shortest between the ventral margin of the torulus and the epistomal sulcus.

detailed.translation: 唇基-触角窝间距|(唇基-触角窝最短距离)

detailed.name: coeloconic sensillum of the galea
detailed.def: The coeloconic sensillum that is located on the medial surface of the galeo-lacinial complex distal to the base of the lacinial lobe.

detailed.translation: 外颚叶腔锥感器|(盔节腔锥感器)

detailed.name: colleterial gland
detailed.def: The glandula mucosa that secretes an adhesive substance used to fasten the eggs to a support.

detailed.name: comb of the spur
detailed.def: The row that is located on the calcar and is composed of hairlike spines.

detailed.name: compound eye
detailed.def: The compound organ that is composed of ommatidia.

detailed.name: compound organ
detailed.def: Anatomical structure that has as its parts two or more multi-tissue structures of at least two different types and which through specific morphogenetic processes forms a single distinct structural unit demarcated by bona fide boundaries from other distinct anatomical structures of different types.

detailed.name: compound organ component
detailed.def: Multi-tissue structure that is part of a compound organ.

detailed.name: condylar carina of the mandible
detailed.def: The carina that is longitudinal and extends posteriorly on the lateral surface of the mandible from the mandibular condyle.

detailed.translation: 上颚髁脊|(上颚髁状隆线)

detailed.name: condylar groove
detailed.def: The impression that extends ventrally of the condylar carina of the mandible.

detailed.name: condyle
detailed.def: The articular surface that is convex and is inserted into the fossa of an adjacent sclerite.

detailed.name: conjunctiva
detailed.def: The area of the cuticle that is more flexible than adjacent sclerites.

detailed.name: contour line
detailed.def: The boundary of the orthographic projection of a defined side of the anatomical structure.

detailed.name: corbicula
detailed.def: The area that is located on the metatibia and is delimited by a fringe of setae arising from the metatibial margins.

detailed.name: cordate apodeme
detailed.def: The apodeme on the anterior margin of female T9. The ventral T9-second valvifer muscle attaches partly on the apodeme.

detailed.name: coriaceous
detailed.def: The reticulate that is composed of convex scutes.

detailed.translation: 革质的|(具凸起小盾片的网状纹饰)

detailed.name: corner
detailed.def: The projection that is located at the intersection of two or more edges.

detailed.name: coronal suture
detailed.def: The suture that is located medially and is part of the epicranial suture.

detailed.name: corpotendon
detailed.def: The anteromedian apodeme on the tentorial bridge that receives the posterior contractor of the pharynx.

detailed.name: costa
detailed.def: The wing vein that is anterior to the subcosta and is connected to the humeral plate.

detailed.name: costal cell
detailed.def: The membranous region of the forewing anterior to the submarginal vein, measured from the basal constriction that delimits the apex of the humeral plate of the wing to the point at which the submarginal vein touches the leading edge of the wing.

detailed.name: costal margin
detailed.def: The margin that delimits the wing anteriorly.

detailed.name: costal notch
detailed.def: The short conjunctiva that is located on a wing vein at the anterior wing margin.

detailed.name: coxa
detailed.def: The leg segment that is connected to the body and to the trochanter via conjunctivae and muscles.

detailed.name: coxal condyle of the pectus
detailed.def: The condyle that is located on the pectus and inserts into the pectal fossa of the coxa.

detailed.name: coxal corium
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that connects the coxa to the pectus.

detailed.name: coxal foramen
detailed.def: The foramen that is located lateroventrally of the pectus, in which the coxa is positioned.

detailed.name: coxopleurite
detailed.def: The pleurite that extends ventrally of the anapleurite and dorsally of the coxa.

detailed.name: cranial condyle
detailed.def: The condyle that is located on the cranium.

detailed.name: cranial condyle of cardo
detailed.def: The condyle of the cardo that inserts into the cardinal condyle of the cranium and is adjacent to the cranial fossa of the cardo.

detailed.translation: 轴节颅骨髁|(轴节颅侧髁)

detailed.name: cranial condyle of the propleuron
detailed.def: The condyle that is located distally on the cervical prominence and inserts into the propleural fossa of the cranium.

synonyms.name: occipital condyle of the cervical prominence

detailed.translation: 前胸侧板头髁|(前胸侧板颅侧髁)

detailed.name: cranial fossa of the cardo
detailed.def: The fossa that is located on the cardo and articulates with the cardinal condyle of the cranium.

detailed.name: cranial scrobe of mesoscutum
detailed.def: The scrobe on the mesonotum that accommodates the posterior surface of the cranium.

detailed.name: cranial scrobe of the pronotum
detailed.def: The scrobe on the pronotum that accommodates the posterior surface of the cranium.

detailed.name: cranio-antennal muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that arises from the cranium and inserts on the scape.

detailed.name: cranio-pharyngeal plate muscle
detailed.def: The head muscle that arises internally from the face and inserts on the pharyngeal plate.

detailed.name: cranium
detailed.def: The sclerite that is articulated with the cervical prominence, the scapes and the mandibles.

detailed.name: crenulate ring of the metasoma
detailed.def: The area that is located posteriorly on the second abdominal tergum and is delimited anteriorly by an impression.

detailed.translation: (后体细齿环)|(后体第二背板后缘细齿环)

detailed.name: crossvein
detailed.comment: There are no crossveins in Hymenoptera.

detailed.name: ctenidium
detailed.def: The process that is located on the annulus.

detailed.name: cubital vein
detailed.def: The longitudinal vein that is posterior to the marginal vein.

detailed.name: cup-shaped apodeme of metabasalare
detailed.def: The apodeme that is cup shaped and recieves the site of insertion of the metabasalar muscles.

detailed.name: cup-shaped socket on pleuron
detailed.def: The projection that is located posteriorly on the subalar area and accommodate the posterior end of the second axillary sclerite of the fore wing at the beginning of the upstroke of the wing.

detailed.name: cupula
detailed.def: The sclerite that is connected via conjunctiva and attached via muscles to abdominal tergum 9 and the gonostyle/volsella complex.

detailed.name: cupulo-gonostyle/volsella complex muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises from the cupula and inserts on the gonostyle/volsella complex.

detailed.name: cuspis
detailed.def: The projection that is located apicolaterally on the parossiculus and is adjacent to the digitus.

detailed.name: cuticle
detailed.def: The acellular anatomical structure that is the external layer of the integument (covers the entire body surface as well as lines ectodermal invaginations such as the stomodeum, proctodeum and tracheae) and produced by the epidermal cells.

detailed.name: cuticular evagination
detailed.def: The area that is evaginated.

detailed.name: cuticular invagination
detailed.def: The area where the cuticle is invaginated.

detailed.name: depression
detailed.def: The area that is external, concave, point-like and does not correspond to an apodeme.

detailed.name: diagonal petiolar length
detailed.def: The anatomical line that extends between the distalmost point of the subpetiolar process and the global minima of the contour line of the dorsal region of the posterior petiolar constriction in lateral view when the specimen is rotated until the contour line became as symmetric as possible.

detailed.name: diameter of propodeal spiracle
detailed.def: The maximum diameter of the first abdominal spiracle.

detailed.name: dicondylic joint
detailed.def: The joint that is composed of two sclerites connected with to articulations.

detailed.translation: 双髁关节|(双关节点关节)

detailed.name: digestive system
detailed.def: The organ system involved in the absorption of nutrients.

detailed.name: digital spine
detailed.def: The projection that is located apically on the gonossiculus.

detailed.name: dilator muscle apodeme
detailed.def: The apodeme that corresponds to the site of origin of the dilator muscle of the propodeal spiracle.

detailed.translation: 开肌内突|(并胸腹节气门开肌附着内突)

detailed.name: dilator muscle of the 2nd abdominal spiracle
detailed.def: The spiracular muscle that arises laterally from the abdominal sternum 2 and inserts on the 2nd abdominal spiracle.

synonyms.name: dilator of the spiracle of abdominal segment II

detailed.phonetic: /daɪˈleɪtə ˈmʌsl ɒv ðə ˈsɛkənd æbˈdɒmɪnl ˈspaɪrəkl/

detailed.name: dilator muscle of the 3rd abdominal spiracle
detailed.def: The spiracular muscle that arises from the lateral sternal apodeme of the abdominal sternum 3 and inserts on the 3rd abdominal spiracle.

synonyms.name: dilator of the spiracles of abdominal segment III

detailed.phonetic: /daɪˈleɪtə ˈmʌsl ɒv ðə θɜːd æbˈdɒmɪnl ˈspaɪrəkl/

detailed.name: dilator muscle of the 4th abdominal spiracle
detailed.def: The spiracular muscle that arises from the lateral sternal apodeme of the abdominal sternum 4 and inserts on the 4th abdominal spiracle.

detailed.phonetic: /daɪˈleɪtə ˈmʌsl ɒv ðə fɔːθ æbˈdɒmɪnl ˈspaɪrəkl/

detailed.name: dilator muscle of the 5th abdominal spiracle
detailed.def: The spiracular muscle that arises from the lateral sternal apodeme of the abdominal sternum 5 and inserts on the 5th abdominal spiracle.

synonyms.name: dilators of the spiracles of abdominal segment V

detailed.phonetic: /daɪˈleɪtə ˈmʌsəl əv ðə fɪfθ æbˈdɒmɪnl ˈspaɪrəkl/

detailed.name: dilator muscle of the 6th abdominal spiracle
detailed.def: The spiracular muscle that arises from the lateral spiracular apodeme of the abdominal sternum 6 and inserts on the 6th abdominal spiracle.

synonyms.name: dilator of the spiracle of abdominal segment VI

detailed.phonetic: /daɪˈleɪtə ˈmʌsl ɒv ðə sɪksθ æbˈdɒmɪnl ˈspaɪrəkl/

detailed.name: dilator muscle of the 7th abdominal spiracle
detailed.def: The spiracular muscle that arises from the lateral sternal apodeme of the abdominal sternum 7 and inserts on the 7th abdominal spiracle.

synonyms.name: dilator of the spiracle of abdominal segment VII

detailed.phonetic: /daɪˈleɪtə ˈmʌsl ɒv ðə ˈsɛvnθ æbˈdɒmɪnl ˈspaɪrəkl/

detailed.name: dilator muscle of the 8th abdominal spiracle
detailed.def: The spiracular muscle that arises anteroventrally from the tergal spiracular plate and inserts on the 8th abdominal spiracle.

synonyms.name: dilator of the spiracle of abdominal segment VIII

detailed.phonetic: /daɪˈleɪtə ˈmʌsəl ɒv ðə eɪtθ æbˈdɒmɪnl ˈspaɪrəkl/

detailed.name: dilator of the propodeal spiracle muscle
detailed.def: The first abdominal tergal spiracle muscle that does not extend between the dorsal and ventral spiraclar apodeme but attaches to one of these apodemes.

detailed.name: discrimen
detailed.def: The sulcus that corresponds with the discrimenal lamella.

detailed.translation: 腹中线|(中胸腹板内脊沟)

detailed.name: discrimenal lamella
detailed.def: The ridge that is median, longitudinal and arises anteriorly from the base of the furca.

synonyms.name: vertical plate of the sternal apophysis

detailed.name: distal cardinal cavity
detailed.def: The area that is limited posterolaterally by the mediodistal and laterodistal cardinal ridges.

detailed.name: distal clypeal line
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is perpendicular to the median anatomical line and is the tangent at the distalmost point(s) of the clypeus in frontal view.

detailed.name: distal crenulate carina
detailed.def: The transverse carina on the posterior abdominal T7 extending parallel to the caudal setal row on T7.

detailed.translation: (远端细锯齿状隆线)|(远端圆齿状脊)

detailed.name: distal fossa of the tarsomere
detailed.def: The fossa that is located distodorsally on the tarsomere and accommodates the proximal condyle of the subsequent tarsomere.

detailed.translation: 跗分节端窝|(跗小节远端凹窝)

detailed.name: distal glossal edge
detailed.def: The transverse edge that extends distally on the glossa.

detailed.name: distal gonostipo-parossiculal muscle
detailed.def: The gonostyle/parossiculal muscle that arises distally of the lateral part of the gonostipes and inserts on the distal part of the parossiculus distally of the site of origin of the proximal gonostipo-parossiculal muscle.

detailed.name: distal gonostyle/volsella complex-harpal muscle
detailed.def: The gonostyle/volsella complex-harpal muscle that inserts on the median wall of the harpe and arises distally of the site of origin of the proximal gonostyle/volsella complex-harpal muscle.

detailed.translation: (远端生殖刺突/阳基腹铁复合体-抱器肌)

detailed.name: distal hypopharyngeal invagination
detailed.def: The invagination on the distal hypopharynx that id adjacent to the concavities of the hypopharyngeal rods.

detailed.name: distal hypopharyngeal sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that receives the site of insertions of the dorsal and ventral premento-salivarial muscles and is continuous with the hypopharyngeal rod.

detailed.name: distal hypopharynx
detailed.def: The area that is located on the anterior surface of the hypopharyngeal wall and is delimited proximally by the infrabuccal pouch or the distal margin of the sitophore, distally by the salivarial orifice and laterally by the lateral parts of the prementum and the hypopharyngeal rods.

detailed.name: distal lobe of the lateral flange of the principal carina of the stipes
detailed.def: The area of the lateral flange of the principal carina of the stipes distal to the notch of the principal carina of the stipes.

relationships.target_name: lateral flange of the principal carina of the stipes

detailed.phonetic: /ˈdɪstəl loʊb ʌv ðə ˈlætərəl flændʒ ʌv ðə ˈprɪnsɪpəl kəˈraɪnə ʌv ðə ˈstaɪpiːz/

detailed.name: distal notch of the dorsal valve
detailed.def: The notch that is distal on the dorsal valve.

detailed.name: distal projection of the parossiculus
detailed.def: The distal projection of the volsella that corresponds to the apical parossiculal seta.

detailed.name: distal projection of the penisvalva
detailed.def: The projection that is at the distal end of the penisvalva.

detailed.translation: 阴茎瓣端突|(阳茎瓣远端突起)

detailed.name: distal tarsal plantula
detailed.def: The tarsal plantula that arises distally on the tarsomere.

detailed.name: distal vertical conjunctiva of the second valvifer-third valvula complex
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that traverses the second valvifer-third valvula complex and is located distal to the median bridge of the second valvifer.

detailed.phonetic: /ˈdɪstəl ˈvɜːtɪkəl ˌkɒndʒʌŋkˈtaɪvə əv ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈvælvɪfə θɜːd ˈvælvjʊlə ˈkɒmplɛks/

detailed.name: distivolsellar apodeme
detailed.def: The apodeme that is located distally on the parossiculus and is the site of insertion of the gonostyle/volsella complex-gonostyle muscle.

detailed.name: distodorsal gonostyle/volsella complex-penisvalval muscle
detailed.def: The dorsal gonostyle/volsella complex-penisvalval muscle that arises distodorsally from the gonostyle volsella complex and inserts on the proximal region of the penisvalva.

detailed.name: distodorsal submedian notch of gonostyle/volsella complex
detailed.def: The notch that is located submedially on the proximodorsal margin of the gonostyle/volsella complex and accommodates the gonossiculus when it is pivotted proximodorsally presumably by the contraction of gonosiculal muscles.

detailed.phonetic: /ˌdɪstəʊˈdɔːsəl sʌbˈmiːdiən nɒtʃ əv ˈɡɒnəstaɪl vɒlˈsɛlə ˈkɒmplɛks/

detailed.name: distolateral galeal sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the lateral wall of the galeo-lacinial complex distaly of the lateral galeal crease and bears the distolateral galeal setiferous patch.

synonyms.name: apical transverse sclerotized part of galea

detailed.name: distolateral galeal setiferous patch
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is located distolaterally on the galeo-lacinial complex.

detailed.name: distolateral premental incision
detailed.def: The concavity on the distal margin of the prementum delimiting medially the site of attachment of the labial palp.

detailed.translation: (前颏端侧切口)|(前颏端侧凹痕)

detailed.name: distolateral projection of the harpe
detailed.def: The projection that is located distolaterally on the harpe.

detailed.name: distomedial stipital flange
detailed.def: The medial part of the principal carina of the stipes that is overlapped by the premental carina and overlaps the lateral premental face.

detailed.name: distoventral gonostyle/volsella complex-penisvalval muscle
detailed.def: The ventral gonostyle/volsella complex-penisvalval muscle that arises from the proximoventral part of the gonostyle/volsella complex, inserts medially on the penisvalva and is oriented distodorsally.

detailed.translation: (腹侧生殖肢/阳基侧突复合体-阴茎瓣端腹向肌肉)

detailed.name: distoventral submedian corner of the cupula
detailed.def: The submedial corner at the distoventral margin of the cupula.

detailed.name: dorsal T8-T9 muscle
detailed.def: The abdominal muscle that arises from the anteromedian margin of female T8 and inserts on the anteromedian margin of the female T9.

detailed.name: dorsal T9-second valvifer muscle
detailed.def: The ovipositor muscle that arises along the posterodorsal part of the anterior margin of female T9 and inserts on the anterior section of the dorsal flanges of the second valvifer.

detailed.translation: 背侧第9背板-第二负瓣片肌肉

detailed.name: dorsal aperture of the phallobase
detailed.def: The foramen that is located proximally on the cupula.

detailed.translation: 阳基基环背孔|(阳茎基背孔)

detailed.name: dorsal apodeme of penisvalva
detailed.def: The apodeme that is located proximodorsally on the aedeagus and is the site of insertion of the distodorsal gonostyle/volsella complex-penisvalval muscle.

detailed.name: dorsal area of the metapectal-propodeal complex
detailed.def: The area of the metapectal-propodeal complex that is located medially of the plicae and anteriorly of the propodeal foramen.

detailed.translation: (后胸侧板-并胸腹节复合体背区)
detailed.phonetic: /ˈdɔːsəl ˈɛəriə ɒv ðə mɛtəˈpɛktəl prɒˈpəʊdiːəl ˈkɒmplɛks/

detailed.name: dorsal area of the metapectus
detailed.def: The area that is part of the metapectal-propodeal complex and is located ventral of the metapleural carina and dorsal of the transmetapectal carina.

detailed.name: dorsal axillar area
detailed.def: The area that is located medially on the axilla and is delimited laterally by the axillar carina and posteromedially by scutoscutellar sulcus.

detailed.name: dorsal flange of the second valvifer
detailed.def: The flange that extends on the dorsal margin of the second valvifer. Part of the ventral T9-second valvifer muscle attaches to the flange.

detailed.name: dorsal head width
detailed.def: The anatomical line between the intersections of the cranium contour and dorsal head line in frontal view.

detailed.name: dorsal incision of the pronotum
detailed.def: The notch that is located submedially on the dorsal margin of the pronotum and fits with the anterior extension of the preaxilla.

detailed.translation: 前胸背板背切刻|(前胸背板背缘缺刻)

detailed.name: dorsal intertergal retractor
detailed.def: The abdominal muscle that attaches to the antecosta of two subsequent abdominal tergites.

detailed.name: dorsal length of mesoscutum
detailed.def: The mesoscutum length in dorsal view.

detailed.name: dorsal length of pronotum
detailed.def: The median anatomical line of the pronotum in dorsal view.

detailed.translation: 前胸背板背中线长|(前胸背板背观中线长)

detailed.name: dorsal length of propodeum
detailed.def: The median anatomical line of the metapectal-propodeal complex in dorsal view.

detailed.name: dorsal mesofurco-profurcal muscle
detailed.def: The profurcal muscle that originates from the lateral part of the lateral mesofurcal arm and inserts on the posterior surface of the posterior profurcal lamella.

detailed.translation: 中胸叉骨-前胸叉骨背肌

detailed.name: dorsal mesometapleural carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends along the dorsal margin of the mesometapleuron.

detailed.translation: 中后胸侧板背脊|(中后胸侧板上缘脊)

detailed.name: dorsal mesopleural inflection
detailed.def: The inflection that extends along the dorsal margin of the mesopleuron anterior to the subalar pit and articulates with the second axillary sclerite.

detailed.translation: 中胸侧板背侧内折|(中胸侧板背侧内弯)

detailed.name: dorsal mesopostnotal flange
detailed.def: The area that is more heavily sclerotised than surrounding areas, traverse the mesopostnotum, unites laterally with the dorsal mesopostnotal flange, continuous laterally with the laterophragma and dorsally (anteriorly) with the pseudophragma and is located anterior to the ventral mesopostnotal flange.

detailed.name: dorsal mesopostnotal incision
detailed.def: The notch that is situated medially on the dorsal margin of the mesopostnotum.

detailed.name: dorsal metafurcal lamella
detailed.def: The ridge that extends along the lateral metafurcal arm and corresponds to the site of origin of the metafurco-second abdominal sternal muscle.

detailed.translation: 后胸叉骨背侧叶板|(后胸叉骨背侧薄片)

detailed.name: dorsal metapleural area
detailed.def: The area that is delimited posterodorsally by the metapleural carina and anteroventrally by the metapleural sulcus.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板上区|(后胸侧板背侧区)

detailed.name: dorsal metapleuro-third axillary sclerite of hind wing muscle
detailed.def: The metapleuro-third axillary sclerite of hind wing muscle that arises dorsolaterally from the mesopleuron dorsally of the vantral metapleuro-third axillary sclerite of hind wing muscle.

synonyms.name: dorsal metapleuro-third axillary sclerite of hind wing

is_a.name: metapleuro-third axillary sclerite of hind wing muscle

relationships.target_name: third axillary sclerite of the hind wing

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板-后翅第三腋片背侧肌
detailed.phonetic: /ˈdɔːsəl ˌmɛtəˈplʊəroʊ-θɜːd ækˈsɪləri ˈsklɪəraɪt ɒv haɪnd wɪŋ ˈmʌsl/

detailed.name: dorsal petiolar carina
detailed.def: The carina that is longitudinal, arises posteriorly from the petiolar collar and extends dorsolaterally on the abdominal tergum 2 medially of the dorsope and the second abdominal spiracle.

detailed.translation: 腹柄背侧隆线|(腹柄背脊)

detailed.name: dorsal petiolar profile
detailed.def: The area of the petiolar node that is dorsomedial, and oriented dorsally and is delimited anteriorly by the anterior petiolar profile and posteriorly by the caudal petiolar profile.

detailed.name: dorsal petiolar profile contour line
detailed.def: The contour line of the dorsal petiolar profile in lateral view.

detailed.name: dorsal petiolar scrobe
detailed.def: The scrobe that is dorsal to the propodeal foramen and accommodates the proximodorsal area of the petiole.

detailed.name: dorsal pharyngeal dilatator
detailed.def: The pharyngeal muscle that arises on the inner proximal surface of the upper face, laterally to the origin of the anterior fronto-labral muscle, but mesally to the posterior fronto-labral muscle.

detailed.name: dorsal plate
detailed.comment: No definition or reference, unclear concept.

detailed.name: dorsal premental adductor
detailed.def: The tentorio-labial muscle that arises from the cranium and inserts distally on the labium adjacent to the level of the salivary orifice.

detailed.name: dorsal premento-salivarial muscle
detailed.def: The salivarial muscle that inserts proximodorsally on the salivary duct.

detailed.name: dorsal prepectal inflection
detailed.def: The inflection that extends along the dorsal margin of the prepectus.

detailed.name: dorsal profurcal lamella
detailed.def: The ridge that extends dorsally on the profurcal arm and corresponds to the site of origin of the dorsal and ventral profurco-postoccipital muscles.

detailed.name: dorsal profurco-postoccipital muscle
detailed.def: The postoccipital muscle that arises from the dorsal part of the lateral area of the dorsal profurcal lamella and inserts on the postocciput.

detailed.name: dorsal profurco-procoxal muscle
detailed.def: The procoxal muscle that arises from along the dorsal profurcal lamella.

detailed.name: dorsal projection of the second valvifer
detailed.def: The projection that is located on the second valvifer and corresponds to the proximal end of the rachis.

detailed.name: dorsal pronotal area
detailed.def: The area that is delimited ventrally by the pronotal suprahumeral sulcus and corresponds to the site of origin of the pronoto-procoxal, pronoto-postoccipital, pronoto-laterocervical and the pronoto-propleural muscles.

detailed.name: dorsal pronotal corner
detailed.def: The corner that is located submedially on the dorsal margin of the pronotum and that is adjacent to the anterolateral mesoscutal corner.

detailed.name: dorsal pronotal inflection
detailed.def: The inflection that extends along the dorsal margin of the pronotum and supports the anterior inflection of the mesoscutum.

detailed.translation: 前胸背板背侧折弯|(前胸背板背侧内折)

detailed.name: dorsal pronoto-procoxal muscle
detailed.def: The pronoto-procoxal muscle that arises dorsomedially from the pronotum.

detailed.name: dorsal propleural area
detailed.def: The area that is located posterodorsally of the well-sclerotized lateral propleural area and usually differs from it in sculpture.

detailed.name: dorsal propleural ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that is marginal or submarginal, extends along the dorsal margin of the propleuron and corresponds to the site of origin of the lateral propleuro-postoccipital muscle.

detailed.translation: 前胸侧板背脊|(前胸侧板背缘脊)

detailed.name: dorsal propodeal inflection
detailed.def: The inflection that extends along the dorsal margin of the propodeum and accommodates the metanotum.

detailed.translation: 并胸腹节背侧内折|(并胸腹节背缘内弯)

detailed.name: dorsal ramus of the first valvula
detailed.def: The region that extends along the dorsal margin of the first valvula and bears the aulax.

detailed.name: dorsal ramus of the second valvula
detailed.def: The area that extends along the dorsal margin of the second valvula, bears the processus articularis anteriorly and the processus musculares on the antero-dorsal region and articulates anteriorly with the second valvifer via the basal articulation.

detailed.name: dorsal rim of pronotal plate
detailed.def: The carina that extends along the posterior border of the pronotal plate.

detailed.name: dorsal rod
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located dorsally between the penisvalvae.

detailed.name: dorsal salivarial wall
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that extends dorsally of the salivarial sclerite between the distal boundary of the salivary duct and the salivary orifice. The dorsal premento-salivarial muscle inserts on the dorsal salivarial wall.

detailed.name: dorsal sclerite of the first valvifer
detailed.def: The sclerite of the first valvifer that is located dorsally of the transvalviferal conjunctiva.

detailed.name: dorsal submedian impression of cupula
detailed.def: The impression that is located dorsolaterally on the cupula and corresponds to the site of origin of the lateral cupulo-gonostipal muscle.

detailed.name: dorsal surface of the mesoscutellum
detailed.def: The area that surrounds the scutellar plate and differs from it in sculpture.

detailed.name: dorsal tendon attachment
detailed.def: The area that corresponds to the site of insertion of the metaphragmo-second abdominal tergal muscle.

detailed.translation: 背腱附着点|(背侧肌腱附着区)

detailed.name: dorsal tentorial arm
detailed.def: The apodeme that arises anterodorsally from the anterior tentorial arm and extends to the anterior wall of the cranium.

detailed.name: dorsal tooth
detailed.def: The apical tooth of mandible that is located closest to the clypeus.

detailed.translation: 上颚背齿|(上颚背侧端齿)

detailed.name: dorsal valve
detailed.def: The area that is articulated with the right and left second valvifers at the basal articulation and bears the rhachises.

detailed.name: dorsalmost digital spine
detailed.def: The apodeme that corresponds to the site of insertion of the gonostyle/volsella complex-volsellal muscles.

detailed.name: dorso-pleural line
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is located between the dorsum and the pleuron.

detailed.translation: 背侧线|(背板-侧板分界线)

detailed.name: dorsolateral cupulo-gonostyle/volsella complex muscle
detailed.def: The cupulo-gonostyle/volsella complex muscle that arises from the dorsolateral part of the cupula, just laterally of the site of origin of the dorsomedian cupulo-gonostipal muscle, and inserts on the dorsolateral part of the gonostipes.

detailed.translation: (背侧杯形骨-生殖肢基侧突复合体肌肉)

detailed.name: dorsolateral setal patch of propodeum
detailed.def: The setal patch that is elongate, is adjacent and extends just lateral to the plica and is composed of posteriorly directed and apressed setae that inserts into the retinaculum when the fore wing is in a flexed position.

detailed.translation: 并胸腹节背侧毛斑|(并胸腹节背外侧毛区)

detailed.name: dorsomedial cupulo-gonostyle/volsella complex muscle
detailed.def: The cupulo-gonostyle/volsella complex muscle that inserts medially on the dorsal region of the gonostyle/volsella complex.

detailed.name: dorsomedian apodeme of the aedeagus
detailed.def: The apodeme that is median and is oriented proximally.

detailed.name: dorsomedian area of the mesoscutellar-axillar complex
detailed.def: The dorsomedian area of the mesoscutellar axillar complex including the scutellar fovea and the mesoscutellar disc.

detailed.translation: (中胸小盾片-腋片复合体背中区)
detailed.phonetic: /ˌdɔːrsəʊˈmiːdiən ˈɛəriə ɒv ðə ˌmɛsəʊˈskjuːtɛlər ækˈsɪlər ˈkɒmplɛks/

detailed.name: dorsomedian conjunctiva of the gonostyle/volsella complex
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that is linear and extends medially on the dorsal region of the gonostyle/volsella complex.

detailed.def: The line that delimits dorsally the scrobal depression.

detailed.name: frontofacial sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that is transverse, located on the upper face and medially joining or intersecting the scrobal sulcus and interantennal area.

detailed.name: frontovertex
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the vertex and the dorsal area of the upper face dorsal to the frontofacial ridge.

detailed.name: functional mouth
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is delimited posteriorly by the distal part of the sitophore and anteriorly by the tormae.

detailed.name: funicle
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of flagellomeres located between the pedicel and clava or the distalmost anellus and clava.

detailed.name: funicle segment
detailed.def: The annulus that is located in the funicle.

detailed.name: funicular segment
detailed.def: The flagellomere that is located in the funicle.

detailed.name: furca
detailed.def: The apodeme that arises medially from the ventral part of the thorax and corresponds to the site of origin of interfurcal and coxal muscles.

detailed.name: furcal arm
detailed.def: The furca that is paired, arises medioventrally from the sternum and corresponds to the furcal pit.

detailed.name: furcal pit
detailed.def: The pit that corresponds to the furca.

detailed.name: furcasternum
detailed.def: The area that is located posteriorly on the prosternum and bears the profurca.

detailed.name: furcula
detailed.def: The sclerite that is proximal to the second valvifer and receives the site of origin of the posterior second valvifer-second valvula muscle.

detailed.translation: (沟; 凹槽; 刻痕; 缝)

detailed.name: gaine
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster composed of the second valvifer and the third valvula.

detailed.name: galea
detailed.def: The lobe that is located on the stipes at the distal part of the posterior stipital sclerite distolateral to the lacinia.

detailed.name: galeal comb
detailed.def: The galeal fringe that is on the lateral margin of the apicolateral galeal plate.

detailed.name: galeal crown
detailed.def: The galeal fringe that extends along the distal margin of the distal galeal plate.

detailed.name: galeal fringe
detailed.def: The row of setae that extends along the margin of the galeo-lacinial complex, distal to the lacinial lobe.

detailed.name: galeal lamina
detailed.def: The lobe that is located medially on the internal wall of the galeo-lacinial complex and margined by the galeal comb.

detailed.name: galeal midrib
detailed.def: The carina that extends medially along the medial wall of the galeo-lacinial complex and that is longitudinal.

detailed.name: galeo-lacinial complex
detailed.def: The area of the stipes that is delimited proximomedially by the stipito-premental conjunctiva, proximolaterally by the stipito-mandibular conjunctiva and posteroproximally by the margin of the posterior stipital sclerite.

detailed.name: gaster
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of all abdominal segments posterior to abdominal segment 2.

detailed.name: gastral scrobe
detailed.def: The scrobe that is located ventrally of the propodeal foramen and accommodates the gaster.

detailed.name: gastral spiracles
detailed.def: The spiracle that is located on the gaster.

detailed.name: gastral sternum
detailed.def: The strenum that is located in the gaster.

detailed.name: gastral tail
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the ovipositor and the distalmost abdominal tergum or the ovipositor and the distalmost abdominal tergum and the preceeding abdominal tergum.

detailed.name: gastral tergite
detailed.def: The tergite that is located on the gaster.

detailed.name: gastral tergum
detailed.def: The tergum that is located in the gaster.

detailed.name: gastrocoelus
detailed.def: The area that is concave, transverse, and located anterolaterally on abdominal tergum 3.

detailed.name: gena
detailed.def: The area that is delimited by the intersection of the interorbital plane, the margin of the compound eye, the margin of the oral foramen, the occipital carina and the malar sulcus.

detailed.name: gena contour line
detailed.def: The contour line of the gena area in frontal view.

detailed.name: genal carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends on the gena from the lateral margin of the oral foramen.

detailed.name: genal patch
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is located on the gena.

detailed.name: genal pilosity
detailed.def: The pilosity that is located on the gena.

detailed.name: genal space
detailed.def: The area that is located between the genal carina and the posterior margin of the compound eye, bounded ventrally by the malar sulcus and dorsally by the vertex.

detailed.name: genital membrane
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that connects the ventral margins of the second valvifers arching above the second valvula.

detailed.name: genitalia
detailed.def: The anatomical system that is involved in copulation, fertilization and/or oviposition.

detailed.name: genuflexor apodeme
detailed.def: The cuticular invagination at the distal end of the genuflexor sclerite that is adjacent to (articulates with) the outerwall of the tibia.

detailed.translation: (膝屈肌腱内突)|(膝屈肌表皮内突)

detailed.name: genuflexor plate
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located posteriorly along the proximal margin of the tibia and corresponds to the site of insertion of the medial femoro-tibial muscle.

detailed.name: genuflexor plate of the fore leg
detailed.def: The genuflexor plate that is located in the fore leg.

detailed.name: genuflexor plate of the hind leg
detailed.def: The genuflexor plate that is located in the hind leg.

detailed.name: genuflexor plate of the mid leg
detailed.def: The genuflexor plate that is located in the mid leg.

detailed.name: gland
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of epithelial cell(s) that secrete or excrete materials not related to their ordinary metabolic needs.

detailed.name: glandular release pit of the scutellum
detailed.def: The area that is concave is located medially on the scutellar plate and corresponds to the opening of an exocrine gland.

detailed.name: glossa
detailed.def: The lobe of the labium that is limited posteroproximally by the prementum, anteroproximally by the fold traversing the salivary orifice and laterally by the paraglossae.

detailed.name: glossal annulus
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster of the glossa that is composed of connected annular hairs.

detailed.name: glossal styloconic sensillum
detailed.def: The styloconic sensillum that is located apically on the glossa.

detailed.name: glymma
detailed.def: The groove that is located between the spiracle and the anterior margin of abdominal tergum 2.

detailed.name: gonad
detailed.def: The compound organ that makes gametes.

detailed.name: gonochoristic organism
detailed.def: Multi-cellular organism that has male and female sexes.

detailed.name: gonocondyle
detailed.def: The apophysis that is located ventromedially on the proximal margin of the cupula and is the site of insertion of the lateral S9-cupulal muscle.

detailed.name: gonoforceps
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located distally of the cupula and dorsolaterally of the volsella, surrounds the aedeagus dorsolaterally and does not connected to any sclerite distally.

detailed.name: gonomacula
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that is located at the distal apex of the harpe.

detailed.name: gonopod
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the gonostipites, volsellae and harpes.

detailed.name: gonossiculal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that inserts on the gonossiculus.

detailed.name: gonossiculo-phallotremal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises from the basiura and inserts on the endophallus.

detailed.name: gonossiculus
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the distoventral part of the gonostyle/volsella complex, and is articulated with the more proximal sclerites of the gononstyle/volsella complex.

detailed.name: gonostipes
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located dorsolaterally on the gonostyle/volsella complex, is connected to the distal margin of the cupula, to the proximal margin of the harpe, and to the lateral margin of the volsella.

detailed.name: gonostipes/volsella complex
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is part of the gonostyle/volsella complex and is composed of the sclerites that are proximal to the harpe.

detailed.name: gonostipital arm
detailed.def: The apodeme that is located proximally on the ventral part of the gonostipes.

detailed.name: gonostipo-volsellal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises proximally from the ventral part of the gonostipes and inserts on the volsella at the border between the gono- and parossiculi.

detailed.name: gonostyle
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of sclerites located distally of the cupula dorsolaterally of the volsella, and that surround the aedeagus.

synonyms.name: outer or central arm of stipes

detailed.name: gonostyle/volsella complex
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the sclerites that are located distally of the cupula and surround the aedeagus.

detailed.name: gonostyle/volsella complex-gonossiculus articulation
detailed.def: The articulation that is composed of the parossiculal articular surface of the gonossiculus and the gonossiculal articular surface of the parossiculus.

detailed.name: gonostyle/volsella complex-gonossiculus muscle
detailed.def: The gonossiculal muscle that arises ventromedially from the gonostyle/volsella complex and inserts laterally on the gonossiculus.

synonyms.name: medial intrinsic muscle of the volsella

detailed.name: gonostyle/volsella complex-harpal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises from the gonostyle/volsella complex and inserts on the harpe.

detailed.name: gonostyle/volsella complex-parossiculal muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that arises ventromedially from the gonostyle, is proximomedially oriented, and inserts on the proximalmost sclerite of the volsella.

detailed.name: gonostyle/volsella complex-penisvalval muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises from the gonostyle/volsella complex and inserts on the penisvalva.

detailed.name: gonostyle/volsella complex-volsellal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises proximoventrally from the gonostyle/volsella complex and inserts nearby the gonossiculal articulation.

detailed.name: gorgeret
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster composed of the second valvifer, second valvula, and third valvula.

detailed.name: gradulus
detailed.def: The carina that is transverse and posteriorly directed laterally and is located on the abdominal tergite.

detailed.name: groove
detailed.def: The line that is located on the sclerite and is impressed.

detailed.name: gular ridge
detailed.comment: There is no gula in Hymenoptera.

detailed.name: gular sulcus
detailed.comment: There is no gula in Hymenoptera.

detailed.name: hairless streak
detailed.def: A bare region of the forewing immediately beyond the basal setal line behind the parastigma.

detailed.name: hairy lobe
detailed.def: The process that is setiferous and is located on the ventral margin of the second valvula and corresponds with one of the subdivisions of the second valvula.

detailed.name: hairy ring of T3
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is extending along the third metasomal tergum.

detailed.name: hairy ring of the metasoma
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that extends along the second metasomal tergum.

detailed.name: hamulus
detailed.def: The seta that is located on the anterior margin of the hind wing and interlocks with the recurved posterior edge of the fore wing in Hymenoptera during flight, making them functionally one winged.

detailed.name: harpe
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located distally on the gonostyle/volsella complex and does not connect to the cupula, and does not connect to the volsella by conjunctiva or muscles.

detailed.name: harpe length
detailed.def: The anatomical line between the distalmost point of the gonostyle volsella complex and the distalmost point of the harpe in lateral view.

detailed.name: harpe width
detailed.def: The width of the harpe in lateral view.

detailed.name: harpo-gonomaculal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises form the harpe and inserts on the gonomacula.

detailed.name: head
detailed.def: The tagma that is located anterior to the thorax.

detailed.name: head capsule
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the cranium and compound eye cuticle.

detailed.name: head height
detailed.def: The median anatomical line of the head in anterior view.

detailed.name: head length
detailed.def: The median anatomical line of the head in dorsal view.

detailed.name: head muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that is located in the head.

detailed.name: head width
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is the longest horizontal diameter of the cranium in frontal view.

detailed.name: hermaphroditic organism
detailed.def: Multi-cellular organism that can produce both male and female gametes.

detailed.name: hind leg
detailed.def: The leg that is located on the metathorax.

detailed.name: hind wing
detailed.def: The wing that is located on the metathorax.

detailed.name: hind wing base
detailed.def: The wing base that is located in the hind wing.

detailed.name: hind wing tegula
detailed.def: The tegula of the hind wing.

detailed.name: hind wing third axillary muscle
detailed.def: The thoracic muscle that inserts on the third axillary sclerite of the hind wing.

detailed.name: horizontal plate
detailed.def: The flange that extends dorsolaterally from the mesodiscrimenal lamella.

synonyms.name: horizontal plate of the mesosternal apophysis

detailed.name: horn of T1
detailed.def: The area that is located anteriorly on mediotergum 1, is raised and contains the proximal part of the retracted ovipositor

detailed.name: humeral complex of the fore wing
detailed.def: The humeral complex that is located on the fore wing.

detailed.name: humeral plate
detailed.def: The sclerite that articulates with the proximal end of the costal vein.

detailed.name: humeral sclerite of the metanotum
detailed.def: The sclerite that is connected to the lateral margin of the metanotum and bears the anterior metanotal wing process.

detailed.name: hyaline break
detailed.def: The costal notch that is on the submarginal vein near the parastigma.

detailed.name: hymenopteran
detailed.def: The multi-cellular organism that is classified in Hymenoptera.

detailed.name: hyperoccipital carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends on the vertex between the outer orbits.

detailed.name: hypochaeta
detailed.def: The mechanosensory hair that projects backward from the anterior margin of the ventral surface of the forewing.

detailed.translation: (下翅毛)|(前翅腹面后向感觉毛)

detailed.name: hypoclypeal depression
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is delimited anteriorly by the clypeus and posteriorly by the labrum.

detailed.name: hypopharyngeal button
detailed.def: The bent area of the hypopharyngeal rod that receives the site of insertion of the posterior tentorio-premental muscle.

detailed.name: hypopharyngeal lobe
detailed.def: The lobe that is situated distally of the sitophore and proximally of the infrabuccal pouch.

detailed.name: hypopharyngeal muscle
detailed.def: The head muscle that inserts on the hypopharyngeal wall.

detailed.name: hypopharyngeal pecten
detailed.def: The anterolateral area of the distal hypopharynx that is adjacent with the proximal part of the hypopharyngeal rod proximal to the hypopharyngeal button and is covered with acanthae.

detailed.name: hypopharyngeal rod
detailed.def: The ligament that connects the proximolateral margin of the prementum with the proximal part of the ligula.

detailed.name: hypopharynx
detailed.def: The area that is delimited proximally by the proximal margin of the sitophore, distally by the salivarial orifice.

detailed.name: hypoproct
detailed.def: The area that is located in between the anal opening and the genitalia.

detailed.name: hypopygium
detailed.def: The abdominal sternum that is the posteriormost visible sclerite located ventrally in the abdomen.

detailed.name: hypostoma
detailed.def: The area that extends on the posterior (ventral) margin of the oral foramen along the site of attachments of the conjunctiva connecting the cranium with the maxillae and is delimited laterally by the pleurostomal fossa.

detailed.name: hypostomal bridge
detailed.def: The subforaminal bridge that is delimited laterally by the dorsally extended hypostomal carina.

detailed.name: hypostomal carina
detailed.def: The carina that delimits the hypostoma from the cranium.

detailed.name: hypostomal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that extends along the posteroventral margin of the cranium between the pleurostomal fossae and delimits the hypostoma.

detailed.name: hypostomal tooth
detailed.def: The projection that is located on the posterolateral margin of the oral foramen at the junction of the hypostoma and the pleurostomal fossa.

detailed.name: immaterial anatomical entity
detailed.def: Anatomical entity that has no mass.

detailed.name: impression
detailed.def: The groove that does not correspond to a ridge.

detailed.name: inferior pronotal spine
detailed.def: The spine that is located laterally on the anterior margin of the pronotum.

detailed.translation: 前胸背板下刺|(前胸背板前缘侧刺)

detailed.name: inflection
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of a ridge that extends along the margin of a sclerite and the marginal area of the sclerite delimited from the sclerite by the ridge articulating with the inflection of another sclerite.

detailed.name: infrabuccal pouch
detailed.def: The pouch that is situated on the hypopharyngeal wall distally of the sitophore.

detailed.name: inner cardinal process
detailed.def: The articular process that is located distomedially on the cardo and articulates with the stipes.

detailed.name: inner lobe of the lacinia
detailed.def: The lacinial lobe that is medial to the outer lobe of the lacinia.

detailed.name: inner orbit
detailed.def: The line that extends along the border between the eye and face.

detailed.name: inner spur
detailed.def: The mesotibial spur that is located anteriorly on the distal margin of the mesotibia.

detailed.name: integrated tarsal plantula
detailed.def: The tarsal plantula that arises medially on the tarsomere.

detailed.name: integument
detailed.def: The anatomical system that forms the covering layer of the animal, ectodermal in origin and composed of epidermal cells producing the cuticle.

detailed.name: interantennal area
detailed.def: The area that is delimited dorsally by the antennal scrobes.

detailed.name: interarticular ridge of the first valvifer
detailed.def: The ridge that extends along the posterior margin of the first valvifer between the intervalvifer and tergovalvifer articulations.

detailed.name: interaxillar sulcus
detailed.def: The median sulcus of the mesonotum between the anterior margin of the mesoscutellar-axillar complex and the anterior margin of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: intercardinal area
detailed.def: The area that is located between the cardines and limited proximally and distally by the anatomical line that extends between the proximal and distal ends of the left and right cardines.

detailed.name: intercardinal sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite on the intercardinal area that is not paired.

detailed.name: intercoxal space
detailed.def: The area that is located between the acetabular carina and the ventral mesopleural carina.

detailed.name: intermalar distance
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is the longest horizontal diameter (major axis) of the oral foramen.

detailed.name: internal male genitalia
detailed.def: The compound organ that functions as producer and transporter of sperm, spermatophore and semen, composed of the testes, vas deferens, accessory glands and ductus ejaculatorius. Ecto- and mesodermal in origin.

detailed.name: internal median longitudinal scutoscutellar ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that is median and is at the posterior region of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: internal metanotal ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that corresponds to the metascutellar arm.

detailed.name: internal protrusion
detailed.def: The rim that extends along the distal margin of the ventral femoral wall.

detailed.name: internal septum
detailed.def: The flange that extends along the margin of the mesoscutellum reducing its opening into the lumen of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: interocellar pit
detailed.def: The pit that is located on the upper face between lateral ocelli and corresponds internally with a conical apodeme and not the tentorium.

detailed.name: interocellar space
detailed.def: The area that is limited posteriorly by the posterior ocellar line and laterally by the lateral ocellar line.

detailed.name: interocular distance
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is perpendicular to the anteroposterior body axis and extends between the medial margins of the compound eyes.

detailed.name: interocular separation
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is the shortest between the compound eyes on the vertex.

detailed.translation: 眼间距|(复眼间最短距离)

detailed.name: interommatidial seta
detailed.def: The seta that is located at the intersection of the margins of three ommatidiae.

detailed.name: interorbital plane
detailed.def: The area that is defined by the anatomical lines that are tangent to a point at the minimal distance from the eyes to the lateral ocelli.

detailed.name: interorbital space
detailed.def: The interocular distance that is the shortest between the inner margin of compound eyes.

detailed.translation: 眼间距|(复眼间最短距离)

detailed.name: interpenisvalval muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that connects the valvurae.

detailed.name: interscrobal surface
detailed.def: The area that is limited laterally by the antennal scrobes.

detailed.name: intersegmental membrane
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that connects two segments.

detailed.name: intersegmental membrane-mesobasalar muscle
detailed.def: The mesobasalar muscle that arises from the intersegmental membrane between the pronotum and the mesopectus and inserts on the mesobasalare.

detailed.translation: 节间膜-中胸基前片肌肉

detailed.name: intersegmentalia
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the intersegmental membrane.

detailed.name: intersternite
detailed.def: The intersegmentalia that is located in between sterna.

detailed.name: interstice
detailed.def: The area that is unsculptured and is delimited by striae or punctures.

detailed.name: interstipital area
detailed.def: The area of the postmental area that is limited laterally by the median margins of the stipites, proximally by the anterior margin of the intercardinal area and distally by the proximal margin of the prementum.

detailed.name: interstipital sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the interstipital area and is connected to the prementum via conjunctiva.

detailed.name: intertarsomeral joint
detailed.def: The monocondylic joint that is composed of two tarsomeres.

detailed.name: intertegular distance
detailed.def: The anatomical line that connects the inner margins of the right and left tegula.

detailed.name: intertergal extensor muscle
detailed.def: The abdominal muscle that attaches to the tergal apodeme of the abdominal tergite and attaches posterior to the antecostal ridge of the subsequent tergite.

detailed.name: intertergal suture
detailed.def: The line of separation that is located between consecutive abdominal terga.

detailed.name: intertorular area
detailed.def: The median area of the face between the dorsal (posterior) margin of the clypeus and the intertolural carina.

detailed.name: intertorular carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends between the dorsal margin of the antennal rims.

detailed.translation: 触角窝间脊|(触角窝间隆线)

detailed.name: intervalvifer articulation
detailed.def: The articulation between the first valvifer and second valvifer.

detailed.name: intervalvula
detailed.def: The sternal sclerite in the venter of the ninth abdominal segment between the second valvifers.

detailed.name: intervolsellal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that connects the proximal part of parossiculi.

detailed.name: intervolsellar process
detailed.def: The projection that is located distomedially on the parossiculus and is continuous with the volsellar ridge.

detailed.name: intragonostyle muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that connects the ventral and dorsal walls of the gonostyle basally.

detailed.name: intravalvifer articulation
detailed.def: The articulation between the dorsal sclerite of the first valvifer and the ventral sclerite of the first valvifer.

detailed.name: intrinsic leg muscle
detailed.def: The leg muscle that inserts and originates in the leg.

detailed.translation: 足部内在肌|足部固有肌

detailed.name: intrinsic maxillary palp muscle
detailed.def: The maxillar muscle that connects two maxillary sclerites.

detailed.translation: 下颚须内在肌|(下颚须固有肌)

detailed.name: intrinsic muscle of the 9th sternum
detailed.def: The sternal muscle that connects the lateral margins of the abdominal tergum 9 and extends internally of the external male genitalia.

detailed.name: intrinsic muscle of the gonostipes
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that connects the dorsal and ventral part of the gonostipes.

detailed.translation: 生殖基节内在肌|(生殖基节固有肌)

detailed.name: intrinsic muscle of the harpe
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises from the proximal margin of the lateral surface of the harpe and inserts proximally on the median surface of the harpe.

detailed.translation: 抱器内在肌|(抱器内附肌)

detailed.name: intrinsic muscle of the mesopleuron
detailed.def: The mesopleural muscle that arises from the mesopleuron.

detailed.translation: 中胸侧板内在肌|中胸侧板固有肌

detailed.name: intrinsic muscle of the metapleuron
detailed.def: The metapleural muscle that arises from the metapleuron.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板内在肌|后胸侧板固有肌

detailed.name: intrinsic muscle of the propleuron
detailed.def: The propleural muscle that arises from the propleuron.

detailed.translation: 前胸侧板内在肌|前胸侧板固有肌

detailed.name: intrinsic palpal muscle
detailed.def: The labial muscle that arises from a palpal sclerite and inserts on the palpal sclerite distal to it.

detailed.translation: 下唇须内在肌|(须节间肌)

detailed.name: joint
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of two sclerites connected by at least one articulation and the articular membrane located connecting the two sclerite.

detailed.name: jugal region
detailed.def: The wing region that is delimited by the plica jugalis.

detailed.name: juxtantennal carina
detailed.def: The carina that is longitudinal and mesal to the antennal base.

detailed.name: kleisiades
detailed.def: The area that is located apically on the gonostyle when it consist only from one sclerite and set off partly by conjunctiva. The kleisiades is never connected to the proximal part of the gonostyle via muscles.

detailed.name: knee
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that consists of the distal part of the femur and the proximal part of the tibia.

detailed.name: labial endite
detailed.comment: Adds an unnecessary layer in the circumscription of glossa and paraglossa

detailed.name: labial gland
detailed.def: The gland that empties between the base of the hypopharynx and the labium, or on the hypopharynx.

detailed.name: labial muscle
detailed.def: The head muscle that inserts on the labium.

detailed.name: labial palp
detailed.def: The anatomical structure that is distal to the proximal margin of the first sclerite of the labial palp.

detailed.name: labial palpal excision
detailed.def: The notch that is located distolaterally on the prementum and receives the base of the labial palp.

detailed.name: labial palpomere
detailed.def: The sclerite that is part of the labial palp.

detailed.name: labial suture
