detailed.name: metapectal-propodeal complex
detailed.def: The sclerite that is connected anteriorly with the mesopectus dorsally with the metanotum, the metabasalare, second axillary sclerite of the hind wing and the metasubalare and articulates with the metacoxae and the metasoma.

detailed.translation: 后胸腹侧-并胸腹节复合体

detailed.name: metapecto-metacoxal joint
detailed.def: The dicondylic joint that is composed of the metapectus, the metacoxa and the articular membrane of the metapecto-metacoxal joint.

detailed.translation: 后胸腹侧片-后足基节关节

detailed.name: metapecto-propodeal conjunctiva
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that connects the lateral end of the antecostal sulcus of the first abdominal tergum with the anterior margin of the metanoto-propodeo-metapecto-mesopectal complex.

detailed.name: metapectus
detailed.def: The area that is located anteriorly of the metapleural sulcus and ridge.

detailed.name: metaphragma
detailed.def: The phragma that corresponds to the site of origin of the mesophragmo-metaphragmal and metaphragmo-second abdominal tergal muscles.

detailed.name: metaphragmal muscle
detailed.def: The thoracic muscle that inserts on the metaphragma.

detailed.name: metapleural apodeme
detailed.def: The pleural apodeme that is connected with the metafurca.

detailed.name: metapleural area of the mesonoto-metanoto-mesopecto-metapecto-propodeal complex
detailed.def: The lateral (vertical) area that is posterior to the mesometapleural sulcus and anterior to the metapleural carina.

detailed.phonetic: /ˌmɛtəˈplʊərəl ˈɛəriə əv ðə ˌmɛsəˈnəʊtəʊ ˌmɛtəˈnəʊtəʊ ˌmɛsəˈpɛktəʊ ˌmɛtəˈpɛktəʊ prɒˈpəʊdiːəl ˈkɒmplɛks/

detailed.name: metapleural arm
detailed.def: The area that is located anterodorsally on the metapleuron.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板臂|(后胸侧板前背区)

detailed.name: metapleural carina
detailed.def: The carina that delimits the metapleuron dorsally from the propodeum, extends from just ventral of the metapleural arm to the metacoxal articulation and passes anteroventral to the propodeal spiracle.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板脊|(后胸侧板背缘脊)

detailed.name: metapleural cavity
detailed.def: The impression that is located at the anteroventral corner of the metapleuron.

detailed.name: metapleural epicoxal carina
detailed.def: The carina that delimits posteriorly the metapleural triangle.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板基节上脊|(后胸侧板基节上隆线)

detailed.name: metapleural epicoxal sulcus
detailed.def: The epicoxal sulcus that extends anteriorly along and close to the metapleural epicoxal carina.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板上基节沟|(后胸侧板上基节缝)

detailed.name: metapleural muscle
detailed.def: The thoracic muscle that inserts on the metapleuron.

detailed.name: metapleural pit
detailed.def: The pleural pit that is corresponds to the metapleural apodeme.

detailed.name: metapleural ridge
detailed.def: The pleural ridge that corresponds to the metapleural sulcus.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板脊|(后胸侧板内脊)

detailed.name: metapleural sulcus
detailed.def: The line that corresponds with the metapleural ridge.

detailed.name: metapleural triangle
detailed.def: The area that is located anteroventrally on the metapectus, is delimited ventrally by the ventral carina of the metapleuron and is triangular.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板三角区|(后胸侧板腹侧三角区)

detailed.name: metapleuro-metabasalar muscle
detailed.def: The metabasalar muscle that arises from the metapleuron and inserts on the metabasalare.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板-后基上片肌肉

detailed.name: metapleuro-metanotal muscle
detailed.def: The metanotal muscle that arises from the metapleuron and inserts on the metanotum.

detailed.name: metapleuro-metasubalar muscle
detailed.def: The metasubalare muscle that arises from the metapleuron and inserts on the metasubalare.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板-后上基片肌肉

detailed.name: metapleuro-metatrochanteral muscle
detailed.def: The metatrochanteral muscle that arises from the metapleuron and inserts on the metatrochanteral apodeme.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板-后胸转节肌肉

detailed.name: metapleuro-propodeal muscle
detailed.def: The propodeal muscle that arises from the metapleuron.

detailed.name: metapleuro-third axillary sclerite of hind wing muscle
detailed.def: The hind wing third axillary muscle that originates from the metapleuron and inserts on the third axillary sclerite of the hind wing.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板-后翅第三腋片肌肉
detailed.phonetic: /ˌmɛtəˈplʊəroʊ θɜːrd ækˈsɪləri ˈsklɪəraɪt ʌv haɪnd wɪŋ ˈmʌsl/

detailed.name: metapleuron
detailed.def: The area of the metapectal-propodeal complex that is located laterally of the metadiscrimen.

detailed.name: metapostnotum
detailed.comment: Based on the definition of the postnotum sensu Snodgrass there is no metapostnotum in Hymenoptera.

detailed.name: metascutellar arm
detailed.def: The area that is elevated and extends along the posterior margin of the metanotum from the metascutellum to the supraalar area.

detailed.name: metascutellar carina
detailed.def: The carina that delimits laterally the metascutellum.

detailed.translation: 后小盾片侧脊|(后胸小盾片侧隆线)

detailed.name: metascutellum
detailed.def: The area that is located posteromedially on the metanotum, is delimited laterally by the metanotal trough and corresponds to the reservoir of the dorsal vessel.

detailed.name: metasoma
detailed.def: The tagma that is connected anteriorly to the metapectal-propodeal complex at the propodeal foramen and consists of abdominal segments.

detailed.name: metasomal condyle of the propodeum
detailed.def: The condyle that is located on the propodeal tooth and inserts into the anterolateral depression of the propodeum.

detailed.name: metasomal depression
detailed.def: The acetabulum that is concave, surrounds the nucha and accommodates the base of the metasoma.

detailed.name: metasomal segment
detailed.def: The abdominal segment that is located in the metasoma.

detailed.name: metasomal spiracle
detailed.def: The metasomal spiracle that is located on the metasomal tergum 7.

detailed.translation: 后体气门|(腹部第7背板气门)

detailed.name: metasomal sternum
detailed.def: The abdominal sternum that is located in the metasoma.

detailed.name: metasomal tergite
detailed.def: The tergite that is located on the metasoma.

detailed.name: metasomal tergum
detailed.def: The abdominal tergum that is located in the metasoma.

detailed.name: metasterno-second abdominal sternal muscle
detailed.def: The second abdominal sternal muscle that arises from the metadiscrimenal lamella.

detailed.translation: 后胸腹板-第二腹板肌肉

detailed.name: metasternum
detailed.def: The eusternum that is located in the metathorax.

detailed.name: metasubalare
detailed.def: The subalare that is located in the metathorax.

detailed.name: metasubalare muscle
detailed.def: The thoracic muscle that inserts on the metasubalare.

detailed.name: metatarsal claw
detailed.def: The tarsal claw that is located in the hind leg.

detailed.name: metatarsomere
detailed.def: The tarsomere that is located in the metatarsus.

detailed.translation: 后足跗分节|后足跗小节

detailed.name: metatarsus
detailed.def: The tarsus that is located in the hind leg.

detailed.name: metatelotarsus
detailed.def: The telotarsus that is located on the metatarsus.

detailed.name: metathorax
detailed.def: The thoracic segment that is located between the mesothorax and the first abdominal tergum and is delimited by the metanotum and the metapectus.

detailed.name: metatibia
detailed.def: The tibia that is located on the hind leg.

detailed.name: metatibial spur
detailed.def: The tibial spur that is located on the metatibia.

detailed.name: metatibio-metabasitarsal articulation
detailed.def: The articulation that is composed of the basitarsal fossa of the metatibia and the tibial condyle of the metabasitarsus.

detailed.name: metatibio-metabasitarsal joint
detailed.def: The monocondylic joint that is composed of the metatibia, the metabasitarsus and the articular membrane of the metatibio-metabasitarsal joint.

detailed.name: metatibio-pretarsus of the metatarsus muscle
detailed.def: The flexor of the pretarsal claws of the hind leg muscle that arises from the metatibia.

is_a.name: flexor of the pretarsal claws of the hind leg

detailed.translation: 后足胫节-后足跗节端跗节屈肌|(后足胫节-端跗节肌肉)

detailed.name: metatrochantellus
detailed.def: The trochantellus that is located on the metafemur.

detailed.name: metatrochanter
detailed.def: The trochanter that is located on the hind leg.

detailed.name: metatrochanteral apodeme
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the proximolateral margin of the metatrochanter and corresponds to the site of insertion of the median metacoxo-metatrochanteral muscle.

detailed.translation: 后足转节内突|(后足转节表皮内突)

detailed.name: metatrochanteral muscle
detailed.def: The leg muscle that inserts on the metatrochanter.

detailed.name: metatrochantero-metafemoral joint
detailed.def: The dicondylic joint that is composed of the metatrochanter, the metafemur and the articular membrane of the metatrochantero-metafemoral joint.

detailed.name: metatrochantero-metafemoral muscle
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises anteriorly from the wall of the metatrochanter and inserts on the proximal metafemoral apodeme.

detailed.name: metatrochantin
detailed.def: The trochantin that is located in the metathorax.

detailed.name: metatrochantinal muscle
detailed.def: The thoracic muscle that inserts on the metatrochantin.

detailed.name: metepimeron
detailed.def: The epimeron that is located on the metapleuron and is located posteriorly of the metapleural sulcus.

detailed.name: metepisternal anapleural cleft
detailed.def: The notch on the anterior margin of the metapectus just ventrally of the metapleural arm.

detailed.name: metepisternal depression
detailed.def: The scrobe that is located anteroventrally on the mesopectus and accommodates the mesocoxa.

detailed.name: metepisternum
detailed.def: The episternum that is located anteroventrally of the metapleural sulcus.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板前片|(后胸前侧片)

detailed.name: microtrichia
detailed.def: The acantha that is on the wing blade.

detailed.name: mid coxa
detailed.def: The coxa that is located on the mid leg.

detailed.name: mid leg
detailed.def: The leg that is located on the mesothorax.

detailed.name: mid ocellar diameter
detailed.def: The diameter of the median ocellus.

detailed.name: midpit
detailed.def: The depression that is located posteromedially on the mesoscutum.

detailed.name: minimum diameter
detailed.def: The diameter that is the shortest.

detailed.name: minimum spine distance
detailed.def: The shortest anatomical line between the lateral margins of the propodeal spines.

detailed.name: minimum width
detailed.def: The width that is the shortest.

detailed.name: mola
detailed.def: The proximomedial region of the mandible that is adjacent to the mola of the opposite mandible and serves as a grinding surface.

detailed.name: monocondylic joint
detailed.def: The joint that is composed of two sclerites that are connected with one articulation.

detailed.translation: 单髁关节|(单关节突关节)

detailed.name: mouth margin
detailed.def: The edge that is located on the cranium along the oral foramen.

detailed.name: mouthparts
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the labrum, epipharyngeal wall, hypopharyngeal wall (including the sitophore), mandibles, maxillae, labium and conjunctivae connecting them.

detailed.name: mucro
detailed.def: The projection that is located distomedially on the hypopygium.

detailed.name: multi-cellular organism
detailed.def: Anatomical structure that is an individual member of a species and consists of more than one cell.

detailed.name: multi-tissue structure
detailed.def: Anatomical structure that has as its parts two or more portions of tissue of at least two different types and which through specific morphogenetic processes forms a single distinct structural unit demarcated by bona-fide boundaries from other distinct structural units of different types.

detailed.name: multilaminar epithelium
detailed.def: Epithelium that consists of more than one layer of epithelial cells.

detailed.name: multiporous gustatory sensillum
detailed.def: The multiporous plate sensillum that is gustatory in function.

detailed.translation: 多孔味觉感器|(多孔味觉板形感器)

detailed.name: multiporous olfactory sensillum
detailed.def: The multiporous plate sensillum that is olfactory in function.

detailed.translation: 多孔嗅觉感器|(多孔板形嗅觉感器)

detailed.name: multiporous plate
detailed.def: The patch that is elevated, located on the flagellomere and is multiporous.

detailed.name: multiporous plate sensillum
detailed.def: The sensillum that corresponds to a multiporous plate.

detailed.name: muscle
detailed.def: The portion of tissue that is composed of contractile fibers.

detailed.name: muscle attachment site
detailed.def: The area of muscle attachment.

detailed.translation: 肌肉附着点|(肌肉附着位)

detailed.name: muscle bearing process of the metanotum
detailed.def: The apodeme that corresponds to the site of insertions of the lateral metapleuro-metanotal muscles.

detailed.name: muscle nd
detailed.def: The muscle that arises from the gonossiculus and inserts on the phalloterama.

detailed.name: nervous system
detailed.def: The organ system that is composed of neurons and glial cells.

detailed.name: musculus retractor unguis
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that originates within the tibia and femur and has a long tendon that inserts through the terminal tarsomere onto the unguitractor.

detailed.name: netrion
detailed.def: The area that is located posteroventrally on the pronotum and corresponds to the site of origin of first flexor of the fore wing muscle.

detailed.name: netrion apodeme
detailed.def: The ridge that extends along the anterior margin of the netrion.

detailed.name: netrion sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that  anteriorly delimits the netrion.

detailed.translation: (后胸侧板前腹沟)|(后胸侧板前腹区沟)

detailed.name: ninth abdominal tergal muscle
detailed.def: The tergal muscle that inserts on female T9.

detailed.name: ninth flagellomere
detailed.def: The flagellomere that is located immediately distal to the eighth flagellomere.

detailed.name: ninth tergal condyle of the first valvifer
detailed.def: The condyle that is located on the first valvifer and articulates with the first valviferal fossa of T9.

detailed.phonetic: /naɪnθ ˈtɜːɡəl ˈkɒndaɪl ɒv ðə fɜːst ˈvælvɪfər/

detailed.name: notal membrane
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that connects the medial margins of the second valvulae.

detailed.name: notaular ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that corresponds with the notaulus.

detailed.name: notaulus
detailed.def: The line that extends submedially along the mesoscutum and corresponds to the median border of the site of origin of the first mesopleuro-mesonotal muscle.

detailed.translation: 盾纵沟|(中胸盾片亚中纵沟)

detailed.name: notch
detailed.def: The part of the margin of a sclerite that is concave.

detailed.name: notopleural suture
detailed.def: The suture that is located between the mesonotum and mesopleuron.

detailed.translation: 背侧缝|(中胸背板侧板缝)

detailed.name: notum
detailed.def: The area that is located dorsally on the thoracic segment and limited laterally by the pleuron.

detailed.name: nucha
detailed.def: The area that is raised and surrounds the propodeal foramen.

detailed.name: nygma
detailed.def: The sclerotized, round patch in the middle of wing cell.

detailed.name: occipital arch
detailed.def: The area that is located on the cranium and is delimited anteriorly by the occipital suture and posteriorly by the postoccipital sutures.

detailed.name: occipital carina
detailed.def: The carina that surrounds dorsolaterally the occiput.

detailed.name: occipital depression
detailed.def: The depression that is located submedially on the occiput, ventral to the occipital carina.

detailed.name: occipital foramen
detailed.def: The foramen that is delimited dorsally by the postocciput.

detailed.name: occipital margin
detailed.def: The edge that separates the occiput from the vertex.

detailed.name: occipital sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that is paired, extends dorsally from the posterior tentorial pit towards lateral ocellus and corresponds with the occipital ridge.

detailed.name: occipital suture
detailed.def: The sulcus that extends between the malar sulcus and the occipital foramen.

detailed.name: occipito-cardinal muscle
detailed.def: The maxillar muscle that arises medially from the occiput dorsally of the occipital foramen and inserts on the proximolateral part of the cardo.

detailed.name: occipito-lacinial muscle
detailed.def: The maxillar muscle that arises from the occiput and inserts on the proximal part of the lacinial lobe.

detailed.name: occiput
detailed.def: The area that is concave and surrounds the postocciput.

detailed.name: occlusor muscle apodeme
detailed.def: The apodeme that corresponds to the site of origin of the occlusor muscle of the thoracic spiracle.

synonyms.name: occlusor muscle apodeme of anterior thoracic spiracle

detailed.translation: 闭肌骨突|(气门闭肌内突)

detailed.name: occlusor muscle apodeme of the mesothoracic spiracle
detailed.def: The apodeme that corresponds to the site of origin of anterior thoracic spiracle occlusor muscle.

synonyms.name: occlusor muscle apodeme of anterior thoracic spiracle

detailed.translation: 中胸气门闭肌内突|(中胸气门闭肌表皮内突)
detailed.phonetic: /əˈkluːsər ˈmʌsl ˈæpədiːm ʌv ðə ˌmɛsəˈθɔːræsɪk ˈspaɪrəkl/

detailed.name: occlusor of posterior thoracic spiracle
detailed.def: The spiracular muscle that arises form the mesopectus and inserts on the posterior thoracic spiracle.

detailed.name: occlusor of the propodeal spiracle muscle
detailed.def: The first abdominal tergal spiracle muscle that extends between the dorsal and ventral spiracular apodemes.

detailed.name: ocellar diameter
detailed.def: The diameter of the ocellus.

detailed.name: ocellar fovea
detailed.def: The depression that extends along the lateral margin of a lateral ocellus or along anterior margin of the anterior ocellus.

detailed.name: ocellar hair patch
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that extends posteriorly or posterolaterally of the median ocellus.

detailed.name: ocellus
detailed.def: The multi-tissue structure that is located on the top of the head, composed of the corneal lens, pigment cell, rhabdoms and synaptic plexus.

detailed.name: ocular ocellar line
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is shortest and connects the compound eye and the lateral ocellus.

detailed.translation: 眼单眼线|(复眼-侧单眼最短连线)

detailed.name: ocular suture
detailed.def: The sulcus that extends along the margin of compound eye and corresponds to the circumocular ridge.

detailed.name: odontoid process
detailed.def: The flange that is located on the ventral edge of the mandible and not continuous with the mandibular condyle.

detailed.name: odontoidea
detailed.def: The articular process that bears the propleural fossa of the cranium.

detailed.name: olistheter
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the rhachis of the second valvula and the aulax of the first valvula.

detailed.name: omaulus
detailed.def: The carina that arises ventrolaterally from of the epicnemial carina and extends dorsally towards the pronotal lobe.

detailed.name: ommatidium
detailed.def: One of the facets of the compound eye.

detailed.translation: 开放型基节臼|(基节窝开放)

detailed.name: operculum
detailed.def: The sclerite that functions like a lid and covers the spiracular opening.

detailed.name: opisthogaster
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of all abdominal segments posterior to abdominal segment 3.

detailed.translation: (可对合的; 对握的; 相对的)

detailed.name: oral foramen
detailed.def: The foramen that is located anteriorly/ventrally on the cranium in which the mouthparts are positioned.

detailed.name: orbicula
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located proximodorsally on the pretarsus and connects the distodorsal margin of the telotarsus with the dorsal part of the arolium.

detailed.name: orbit
detailed.def: The margin of the compound eye.

detailed.name: orbital band
detailed.def: The band that extends along the medial margin of the eye.

detailed.name: orbital furrow
detailed.def: The impression that arises laterally from the antennal rim and extends along the inner margin of the compound eye.

detailed.name: organ system
detailed.def: A division of the whole organism into specialized systems.

detailed.name: organism subdivision
detailed.def: Anatomical structure which is a primary subdivision of whole organism. The mereological sum of these is the whole organism.

detailed.name: outer cardinal process
detailed.def: The articular process that is located distolaterally on the cardo and articulates with the stipes.

detailed.name: outer carina of the mandible
detailed.def: The carina that is longitudinal and extends anteriorly on the lateral surface of the mandible.

detailed.translation: 上颚外隆线|(上颚外侧脊)

detailed.name: outer groove
detailed.def: The impression that extends dorsally of the condylar carina of the mandible.

detailed.name: outer lobe of the lacinia
detailed.def: The lacinial lobe that is lateral to the inner lobe of the lacinia.

detailed.name: outer orbit
detailed.def: The line that extends along the border between the eye and gena.

detailed.name: ovipore
detailed.def: The anatomical space that receives sperm ejected from the aedeagus.

detailed.name: ovipositor
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the first valvulae, second valvulae, third valvulae, first valvifers, second valvifers and female T9.

detailed.name: ovipositor apparatus
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the ovipositor, abdominal terga 8-10, abdominal sternum 7 and muscles connecting them.

detailed.translation: 产卵器结构|(产卵器复合体)

detailed.name: ovipositor clip
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the distal notch on the second valvula and the associated dentition and flexible flap.

detailed.name: ovipositor muscle
detailed.def: The abdominal muscle that inserts on the ovipositor.

detailed.name: ovipositor sheath
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the third valvulae.

detailed.name: paddle shaped seta
detailed.def: The sensillum with a paddle-shaped cuticular componenet on the probasitarsus.

detailed.name: palpal formula
detailed.def: The ratio of the number of the maxillary sclerites and labial sclerites.

detailed.name: palpal fossa of the prementum
detailed.def: The fossa that accommodates the base of the labial palp.

detailed.name: palpifer
detailed.def: The area that is located on the stipes and which articulates with the maxillary palp.

detailed.name: palpiger
detailed.def: The sclerite that is between the basal segment of the labial palp and the prementum.

detailed.name: palpomere
detailed.def: The sclerite that is part of the palp.

detailed.name: palpus
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the palpal segments.

detailed.name: paraclypeal margin
detailed.def: The edge that extends laterally of the pleurostoma.

detailed.name: paracoxal notch
detailed.def: The notch that is at the lateral end of the paracoxal sulcus.

detailed.name: paracoxal ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that extends along the anterior margin of the metapectus.

detailed.name: paracoxal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that corresponds to the paracoxal ridge.

detailed.name: paraglossa
detailed.def: The lobe that is connected to the distal margin of the prementum posteroproximally, to the premental hypopharynx proximolaterally and anteroproximally, to the glossa proximomedially and bears the basiparaglossal brush and the paraglossal sclerite.

detailed.name: paraglossal acroglossal button
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located distally on the paraglossa.

detailed.name: paraglossal annulus
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster of the paraglossa that is composed of connected annular hairs.

detailed.name: paraglossal sclerite
detailed.def: The anteroproximal sclerite of the paraglossa that bears the basiparaglossal brush.

detailed.name: paramandibular process
detailed.def: The projection that is located distolaterally on the hypostoma and extends to the clypeus separating the mandibular socket from the oral foramen.

detailed.name: parameral seta
detailed.def: The seta that is located apically on the gonstyle.

detailed.name: paraocular area
detailed.def: The area that is located on the face and delimited ventromedially by the epistomal sulcus.

detailed.name: paraocular carina
detailed.def: The carina that surrounds the compound eye.

detailed.name: paraocular lobe
detailed.def: The area that is located ventromedially on the paraocular area and is surrounded partly by the epistomal sulcus.

detailed.name: parapenis
detailed.def: The area that is the dorsomedian part of the gonostipes and is the site of origin of the distodorsal and proximodorsal gonostyle/volsella complex-penisvalval muscles.

detailed.name: parapenisjugum
detailed.def: The area that is narrow and connects the parapenis with the rest of the gonostipes.

detailed.name: parapsidal furrow
detailed.def: The impression that extends along the parapsidal line.

detailed.name: parapsidal hair line of mesoscutum
detailed.def: The row of setae that extends along the parapsidal line.

detailed.name: parapsidal line
detailed.def: The signum that is located between the notaulus and the parascutal carina and corresponds to the site of origin of the dorsoventral indirect flight muscle.

detailed.name: parapsidal ridge
detailed.def: The carina that extends along the parapsidal line.

detailed.name: parapsis
detailed.def: The area that is delimited medially by the parapsidal line and laterally by the parascutal carina.

detailed.name: parascrobal area
detailed.def: The area that is located on the upper face, is delimited medially by the antennal scrobe and laterally by the inner orbit.

detailed.name: parascutal carina
detailed.def: The rim that extends along the lateral margin of the lateral area of the mesoscutum and delimits the preaxilla.

detailed.name: paraspiracular carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends along the lateral margin of the paraspiracular sulcus.

detailed.name: paraspiracular sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that is longitudinal and extends posteriorly of the first abdominal spiracle.

detailed.translation: (气门侧沟)|(并胸腹节气门侧沟)

detailed.name: paravalva
detailed.def: The projection that is lateral and located apically on the penisvalva.

detailed.name: parietal
detailed.def: The area that is lateral on the cranium between the frontal and occipital areas, separated above by the coronal suture.

detailed.name: parietal band
detailed.def: The band that is located on the anterior part of the larval head.

detailed.name: parossiculo-penisvalval muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises from the proximal apex of the parossiculus and inserts medially on the penisvalva. The muscle inserts on the ergot if present.

detailed.name: parossiculo-phallotremal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that originates from the parossiculus and inserts on the endophallic membrane around the phallotrema.

detailed.name: parossiculus
detailed.def: The sclerite that is connected via conjunctiva distomedially to the gonostipes, and articulates with the gonossiculus.

detailed.name: pars articulares
detailed.def: The articular surface that is situated on the anteriorly on the ventral margin of the second valvifer and forms the lateral part of the basal articulation.

detailed.name: part_of
detailed.def: The muscle that arises anteromedially from the second valvifer and inserts inside the lumen of second valvula.

detailed.name: patch
detailed.def: The area that is round and differs from surrounding regions in sculpture, setae, and/or pigmentation.

detailed.name: pectal fossa of the coxa
detailed.def: The fossa that is located on the coxa and accommodates the coxal condyle of the pleuron.

detailed.name: pecto-coxal joint
detailed.def: The joint that is composed of the pectus, the coxa and the articular membrane of the pecto-coxal joint.

detailed.name: pectus
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located ventrally of the thoracic segment and bears the furca and the lateral coxal condyle of the pleuron.

detailed.name: pedicel
detailed.def: The antennal segment that is connected proximally to the scape and distally to the flagellum.

detailed.name: peduncle
detailed.def: The area that is located anteriorly on the petiole, delimited posteriorly by constriction and bears the propodeal fossa of the petiole.

detailed.name: penisvalva
detailed.def: The sclerite that is in the middle of the external male genitalia, surrounds the distal part of the ductus ejaculatorius and the endophallus.

synonyms.name: inner or dorsal arm of the stipes

detailed.name: penisvalval muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that inserts on the penisvalva.

detailed.translation: 阳茎瓣肌肉|(阳茎基侧突肌肉)

detailed.name: penisvalvo-gonossiculal muscle
detailed.def: The gonossiculal muscle that arises from the penisvalva.

detailed.name: penisvalvo-median sclerotized style muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that attaches to the median sclerotized style and to the valvura.

detailed.name: penisvalvo-phallotremal muscle
detailed.def: The male genitalia muscle that arises from the medial surface of the proximal part of the penisvalva and inserts on the endophallus just around the phallotrema.

detailed.name: periepistomal striation
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that composed of carinae radiating from the pleurostomal condyle.

detailed.name: peristome
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that comprises the ventral marginal of the cranium, including the clypeus, the pleurostomata, and the hyperstomata.

detailed.name: peritreme
detailed.def: A sclerotic ring surrounding the outer spiracular opening.

detailed.translation: 气门围片|(气门周缘骨环)

detailed.name: petiolar flange
detailed.def: The area that is located anteriorly on the second metasomal sternum and overlaps ventrally the petiole.

detailed.translation: (腹柄腹侧凸缘)|(第二后体腹板前侧突)

detailed.name: petiolar lamina
detailed.def: The evagination that is located on the posterior margin of the petiole, paired and overlaps the anterior region of the first gastral sternite.

detailed.name: petiolar scrobe
detailed.def: The scrobe that is located ventrally of the propodeal foramen and accommodates the proximal area of the petiole.

detailed.name: petiole length
detailed.def: The median anatomical line that extends between the transverse carina on petiole and the posterior margin of the petiole.

detailed.name: petiole neck
detailed.def: The anterior area of the petiole that is narrower than the posterior region in dorsal view.

detailed.name: petiole width
detailed.def: The maximum width of the petiole in dorsal view.

detailed.name: phallobase
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the cupulae, gonostipites and volsellae.

detailed.name: phallotrema
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is the distal opening of the endophallus.

detailed.name: pharate adult
detailed.def: The developing adult after pupal-adult apolysis, i.e. from stage P8 (when yellow eye color first becomes visible through the pupal case), to eclosion.

detailed.name: pharyngeal muscle
detailed.def: The head muscle that inserts on the pharynx.

detailed.name: pharyngeal wall
detailed.def: The area that is anterior on the foregut and that is situated posterior to the cibarium.

detailed.name: pharynx
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is located proximal to the cibarium.

detailed.name: phragma
detailed.def: The antecosta that corresponds to the site of attachment of the dorsal longitudinal muscles in the thorax.

detailed.name: pile
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of fine, dense setae, acanthae or microtrichiae.

detailed.name: pilosity
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of setae.

detailed.name: pit
detailed.def: The patch that is impressed and corresponds to an apophysis.

detailed.name: planta
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located proximoventrally on the pretarsus and is connected proximally with the unguitractor plate and distally with the arolium.

detailed.name: pleated membrane
detailed.def: The accordion-like conjunctiva separates the occiput from the rest of the head capsule. The structure arises laterally at the base of the mandible.

detailed.name: pleural apodeme
detailed.def: The apodeme that is located on the pleuron.

detailed.translation: 侧板内突|(侧板表皮内突)

detailed.name: pleural apophysis
detailed.def: The apophysis that is adjacent to the pleural ridge.

detailed.name: pleural area
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster composed of the pro-, meso-, and metapleura.

detailed.name: pleural pit
detailed.def: The pit that is located on the pleuron and corresponds to the pleural apophysis.

detailed.name: pleural pit line
detailed.def: The anatomical line between the mesopleural and metapleural pits.

detailed.name: pleural suture
detailed.def: The sulcus that corresponds to the pleural ridge and separates the episternum from the epimeron.

detailed.name: pleural ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that extends between the pleural wing process and the lateral coxal articulation and marks the border between the episternum and epimeron.

detailed.name: pleural wing process
detailed.def: The fossa that is located on the dorsal margin of the pleuron and accommodates the second axillary sclerite.

detailed.name: pleurite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the pleuron.

detailed.name: pleuro-ventral line
detailed.def: The line of separation between the pleural region and the venter, lying mesad of the limb bases, but obscured when the latter are fused with the sterna.

detailed.name: pleuron
detailed.def: The sclerite that articulates with the leg and is connected along its dorsal margin with the notum and ventral margin with the sternum.

detailed.name: pleurostoma
detailed.def: The area that extends on the ventral (anterior) margin of the cranium along the site of origin of the conjunctiva connecting the mandible with the cranium and is delimited posteriorly (ventrally) by the posterior (ventral) margin of the pleurostomal fossa and anteriorly (dorsally) by the anterior (dorsal) margin of the pleurostomal condyle and laterally by the mouth margin.

detailed.name: pleurostomal carina
detailed.def: The carina that delimits the pleurostoma from the cranium.

detailed.name: pleurostomal condyle
detailed.def: The condyle that is located on the anterior (dorsal) margin of the pleurostoma and inserts into the mandibular acetabulum.

detailed.name: pleurostomal fossa
detailed.def: The fossa that is located postero- (ventro-) medially on the pleurostoma and accommodates the mandibular condyle.

detailed.name: pleurostomal ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that extends between the pleurostomal fossa and pleurostomal condyle and delimits the lateral margin of the pleurostoma.

detailed.name: pleurostomal suture
detailed.def: The suture that is dorsal to the mandible and is part of the subgenal suture.

detailed.name: plica
detailed.def: The carina that arises from the anterior margin of the abdominal tergum 1 medially of the propodeal spiracle extends to the posterior propodeal projection.

detailed.translation: (并胸腹节侧纵脊)|(前腹背板侧褶)

detailed.name: plica basalis
detailed.def: The wing fold that is located between the mediocubital field and axillary region.

detailed.name: plica vannalis
detailed.def: The wing fold that is located between the cubital field and the first vannal vein.

detailed.name: plical area
detailed.def: The area that is delimited laterally by the metapleural carina and medially by the plica.

detailed.name: pollen press
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the auricle and the rastellum.

detailed.name: pollex
detailed.def: The area corresponding to the upper margin of the mandible, above the acetabular groove, commonly ending in the preapical tooth or teeth.

detailed.name: portion of cell substance
detailed.def: Portion of organism substance located within a cell.

detailed.name: portion of epithelium
detailed.def: The anatomical structure of the epithelium that is delimited by material or immaterial anatomical entities.

detailed.name: portion of organism substance
detailed.def: Material anatomical entity in a gaseous, liquid, semisolid or solid state; produced by anatomical structures or derived from inhaled and ingested substances that have been modified by anatomical structures as they pass through the body.

detailed.name: portion of tissue
detailed.def: Anatomical structure, that consists of similar cells and intercellular matrix, aggregated according to genetically determined spatial relationships.

detailed.name: post-ramus flap
detailed.def: The distal area of the dorsal projection of the second valvifer that is widened and is flexibly connected to the proximal region of the dorsal projection of the second valvifer.

detailed.name: postacetabular patch
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is located ventrally on the mesopleuron posterior to the epicnemial carina.

detailed.name: postacetabular pits
detailed.def: Paired submedian pits located just posterior to the acetabular carina.

detailed.name: postacetabular sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that extends posteriorly along the epicnemial carina.

detailed.name: postalar process
detailed.def: The process that is located anterolaterally on the mesoscutellar-axillar complex and separates the site of origin of the fore wing from the site of origin of the hind wing.

detailed.name: postarticular portion of the postmentum
detailed.def: The intercardinal sclerite that is connected distally to the prearticular portion of the postmentum.

detailed.name: postclypeus
detailed.def: The area that is located on the clypeus and is delimited by the epistomal sulcus and a medial transverse anatomical line.

detailed.name: postcubitus
detailed.def: The usual sixth vein of the wing, associated basally with the cubitus.

detailed.name: postepomial sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus along the dorsal margin of the transverse pronotal carina that is posterior to the epomial carina and ventral to the pronotal suprahumeral sulcus

detailed.name: posterior T9-second valvifer muscle
detailed.def: The ovipositor muscle that arises medially from the posterodorsal part of female T9 and inserts on the median bridge of the second valvifers.

detailed.translation: 后侧第9背板-第二负瓣片肌肉

detailed.name: posterior area of the second valvifer
detailed.def: the area of the second valvifer that is posterior to the anatomical line that is the shortest distance from the first valviferal fossa of the second valvifer to the ventral margin of the second valvifer

detailed.name: posterior carina of subaxillular bar
detailed.def: The carina that delimits posteriorly the subaxillular bar.

detailed.name: posterior coxal fossa of the mesotrochanter
detailed.def: The fossa that is located posteriorly on the proximal margin of the mesotrochanter accommodating the posterior trochanteral condyle of the mesocoxa.

detailed.name: posterior coxal fossa of the metatrochanter
detailed.def: The fossa that is located posteriorly on the proximal margin of the metatrochanter and accommodates the posterior trochanteral condyle of the metacoxa.

detailed.name: posterior coxal fossa of the protrochanter
detailed.def: The fossa that is located posteriorly on the proximal margin of the protrochanter accommodating the posterior trochanteral condyle of the procoxa.

detailed.name: posterior cranio-mandibular articulation
detailed.def: The cranio-mandibular articulation that is composed of the mandibular condyle and the pleurostomal fossa.

detailed.translation: 后颅-上颚关节|(后头-上颚关节)

detailed.name: posterior cranio-mandibular muscle
detailed.def: The mandibular muscle that arises posterolaterally from the cranium and inserts on the tendon attached posteroproximal part of the mandible.

detailed.name: posterior extension of preaxilla
detailed.def: The area that is located on the posteroventral corner of the preaxilla and articulates with the anterior extension of the lateral axillar area.

detailed.name: posterior femoro-tibial articulation
detailed.def: The articulation that is composed of the posterior tibial condyle and fossa of the femur and the posterior femoral condyle and fossa of the tibia.

detailed.translation: 后股胫关节|(后股胫连接处)

detailed.name: posterior glossal plate
detailed.def: The area that is delimited laterally distally and proximally by the sclerites that are connected to the distal margin of the prementum and receive the site of insertion of the premento-paraglossal muscle.

detailed.name: posterior glossal sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite of the posterior glossal plate that is paired.

detailed.name: posterior labral retractor
detailed.def: The labral muscle that arises from the upper face laterally to the anterior fronto-labral muscle and inserts on the torma.

detailed.name: posterior lacinial fimbriae
detailed.def: The row of setae that traverses the lacinia along its posterior margin.

detailed.name: posterior lobe of scutellum
detailed.def: The part of the mesoscutellum that protrudes posteriorly as a distinct shape beyond any smooth or straight posterior outline, especially when protruding posteriorly past the anterior margin of the metanotum

detailed.name: posterior margin of the first valvifer
detailed.def: The margin of the first valvifer that is posterior and extends between the intervalvifer articulation and the anterior angle of the first valvifer.

detailed.name: posterior mesepimeral area
detailed.def: The area that extends along the posterior margin of the mesopleuron and is delimited anteriorly by the mesepimeral sulcus.

detailed.name: posterior mesepimeral inflection
detailed.def: The inflection that extends along the posterior margin of the mesepimeron, posteriorly of the subalar pit to the coxal articulation.

detailed.name: posterior mesocoxo-mesotrochanteral articulation
detailed.def: The articulation that is composed of the posterior trochanteral condyle of the mesocoxa and the posterior coxal fossa of the mesotrochanter.

detailed.name: posterior mesocoxo-mesotrochanteral muscle
detailed.def: The mesotrochanteral muscle that arises posteriorly from the mesocoxa and inserts posteriorly on the mesotrochanter laterally of the posterior mesocoxo-mesotrochanteral articulation.

synonyms.name: posterior levator of the middle trochanter

detailed.name: posterior mesofemoro-mesotibial articulation
detailed.def: The posterior femoro-tibial articulation that is composed of the posterior tibial condyle and fossa of the mesofemur and the posterior femoral condyle and fossa of the mesotibia.

detailed.name: posterior mesofurco-mesolaterophragmal muscle
detailed.def: The mesolaterophragmal muscle that originates from the mesofurca and inserts on the mesolaterophragma posterior to the site of origin of the anterior mesofuco-mesolaterophragmal muscle.

detailed.name: posterior mesonoto-mesotrochanteral muscle
detailed.def: The mesonoto-mesotrochanteral muscle that arises from the dorsal axillar area, posteriorly of the site of origin of the anterior mesonoto-mesotrochanteral muscle (if present) and inserts on the mesotrochanteral apodeme.

detailed.translation: 后中胸背板-中胸转节肌

detailed.name: posterior mesonoto-metanotal muscle
detailed.def: The mesonoto-metanotal muscle that arises from the mesoscutellum.

detailed.translation: 后中胸背板-后胸背板肌

detailed.name: posterior mesopleuro-mesofurcal muscle
detailed.def: The mesofurcal muscle that originates proximally from the mesofurca and inserts on the mesopleuron.

detailed.translation: 后中胸侧板-中胸叉骨肌

detailed.name: posterior mesopleuro-third axillary sclerite of fore wing muscle

detailed.phonetic: /pɒˈstɪəriə ˌmɛsəʊˈplʊərəʊ θɜːd ækˈsɪləri ˈsklɪəraɪt ɒv fɔː wɪŋ ˈmʌsl/

detailed.name: posterior mesoscutal width
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is between the anterior margins of the left and right preaxillae.

detailed.name: posterior mesoscutellar area
detailed.def: The area delimited by the posterior mesoscutellar carina and by the posterior margin of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: posterior mesoscutellar carina
detailed.def: The carina on the posterior face of the mesoscutellum that is dorsally convex.

detailed.translation: 中胸小盾片后隆线|(中胸小盾片后脊)

detailed.name: posterior mesoscutellar ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that delimits posteriorly the pulsatory organ of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: posterior mesoscutellar sulcus
detailed.def: The line that extends along the posterior margin of the mesoscutellum and corresponds to the posterior mesoscutellar ridge.

detailed.name: posterior mesosomal comb
detailed.def: The row of setae that extends along the posterolateral edge of the metanoto-propodeo-mesopecto-metapectal complex and the metacoxa.

detailed.name: posterior mesotibio-mesobasitarsal muscle
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises posteriorly from the mesotibia and inserts on the posterior proximal process of the mesobasitarsus.

detailed.name: posterior metacoxo-metatrochanteral articulation of the metacoxa
detailed.def: The articulation that is composed of the posterior trochanteral condyle of the metacoxa and the posterior coxal fossa of the metatrochanter.

detailed.translation: 后胸基节-后胸转节后关节

detailed.name: posterior metafemoro-metatibial articulation
detailed.def: The posterior femoro-tibial articulation that is composed of the posterior tibial condyle and fossa of the metafemur and the posterior femoral condyle and fossa of the metatibia.

detailed.translation: 后足股胫后关节|(后足股节-胫节后关节)

detailed.name: posterior metanoto-metacoxal muscle
detailed.def: The metacoxal muscle that arises from the metanotum posterior to the site of origin of the anterior metanoto-metacoxal muscle.

detailed.name: posterior metapleuro-metabasalar muscle
detailed.def: The metapleuro-metabasalar muscle that arises posterior to the paracoxal ridge.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板-后上基节后肌|(后胸侧板-后基翅片后肌)

detailed.name: posterior metapleuro-metafurcal muscle
detailed.def: The metafurcal muscle that arises posteriorly of the site of origin of the anterior metapleuro-metafurcal muscle.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板-后胸叉骨后肌

detailed.name: posterior metatibio-metabasitarsal muscle
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises posteriorly from the metatibia and inserts on the posterior proximal process of the metabasitarsus.

detailed.translation: 后足胫节-后足基跗节后侧肌

detailed.name: posterior notal wing process
detailed.def: The articular process that is located on the lateral margin of the alinotum and articulates with the first axillary sclerite.

detailed.name: posterior ocellar line
detailed.def: The anatomical line that is the shortest between the margin of the lateral ocelli.

detailed.translation: 后单眼线|(侧单眼后缘间最短连线)

detailed.name: posterior paracoxal ridge
detailed.def: The paracoxal ridge that is posterior to the site of origin of the posterior metapleuro-metabasalar muscle.

detailed.translation: (后基节旁脊)|(后胸侧板后基节旁隆线)

detailed.name: posterior part of pronotal plate
detailed.def: The area of the pronotal plate that is posterior to the pronotal foveae.

detailed.name: posterior prepectal inflection
detailed.def: The inflection that extends along the posterior margin of the prepectus.

detailed.name: posterior procoxo-protrochanteral articulation
detailed.def: The articulation that is composed of the posterior trochanteral condyle of the procoxa and the posterior coxal fossa of the protrochanter.

detailed.name: posterior procoxo-protrochanteral muscle
detailed.def: The protrochanteral muscle that arises posteriorly form the procoxa and inserts on the proximal margin of the protrochanter just laterally of the posterior coxal fossa of the protrochanter.

synonyms.name: posterior levator of the fore trochanter

detailed.name: posterior profemoro-protibial articulation
detailed.def: The posterior femoro-tibial articulation that is composed of the posterior tibial condyle and fossa of the profemur and the posterior femoral condyle and fossa of the protibia.

detailed.translation: 后侧前股-前胫关节|(前足股胫后关节)

detailed.name: posterior profurcal lamella
detailed.def: The ridge that extends along the dorsal margin of the dorsal profurcal lamella and corresponds to the site of origin of the lateral profurco-procoxal muscle.

detailed.name: posterior projection of mesoscutellum
detailed.def: The paired process that is located posteriorly on the dorsal surface of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: posterior pronotal inflection
detailed.def: The inflection that extends along the posterior margin of the pronotum and articulates with the anterior mesopleural inflection.

detailed.translation: 前胸背板后折弯|(前胸背板后内折)

detailed.name: posterior pronotal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that extends parallel with the posterior margin of the pronotum and corresponds to the ridge of the posterior pronotal inflection.

detailed.name: posterior pronoto-laterocervical muscle
detailed.def: The pronoto-laterocervical muscle that originates from the pronotum posterior to the anterior pronoto-laterocervical muscle and inserts on the laterocervical apodeme.

detailed.translation: 后前胸背板-侧颈片肌肉

detailed.name: posterior propleuro-postoccipital muscle
detailed.def: The postoccipital muscle that arises posterodorsally from the propleuron.

detailed.name: posterior propodeal projection
detailed.def: The propodeal spine that is located posteromedially of the first abdominal spiracle.

detailed.name: posterior protibio-probasitarsal muscle
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises posteriorly from the protibia and inserts on the posterior proximal process of the probasitarsus.

detailed.name: posterior proximal process of the mesobasitarsus
detailed.def: The process that is located posteriorly on the proximal margin of the mesobasitarsus and corresponds to the site of insertion of the posterior mesotibio-mesobasitarsal muscle.

detailed.name: posterior proximal process of the metabasitarsus
detailed.def: The process that is located posteriorly on the proximal margin of the metabasitarsus and corresponds to the site of insertion of the posterior metatibio-metabasitarsal muscle.

detailed.name: posterior proximal process of the probasitarsus
detailed.def: The process that is located posteriorly on the proximal margin of the probasitarsus and corresponds to the site of insertion of the posterior protibio-probasitarsal muscle.

detailed.name: posterior rim of the propodeum
detailed.def: The rim that extends along the propodeal foramen.

detailed.name: posterior scutellar depression
detailed.def: The line that extends just posterior of the posterior mesoscutellar ridge/mesoscutellar arms and delimits the posterior margin of the mesoscutellar pulsatory organ and the anterior margin of the mesopostscutellum.

detailed.translation: 小盾片后洼|(小盾片后凹陷)

detailed.name: posterior scutellum
detailed.def: The area that is posterior and set of from the mesoscutellum by a transverse line.

detailed.name: posterior scutum
detailed.def: The area that is located posteriorly on the mesoscutum.

detailed.translation: 中胸盾片后区|(中胸盾片后部)

detailed.name: posterior second valvifer-second valvula muscle
detailed.def: The ovipositor muscle that arises posteroventrally from the second valvifer and inserts on the processus musculares of the second valvula.

detailed.translation: 后第二负瓣片-第二产卵瓣肌

detailed.name: posterior section of dorsal flange of second valvifer
detailed.def: The area of the dorsal flange of the second valvifer that is posterior to the to the site of origin of the basal line.

relationships.target_name: dorsal flange of the second valvifer

detailed.phonetic: /pɒˈstɪəriə ˈsɛkʃən ɒv ˈdɔːsəl flændʒ ɒv ˈsɛkənd ˈvælvɪfə/

detailed.name: posterior stipital sclerite
detailed.def: The sclerite that is located on the posterior stipital wall, articulates with the cardo and with the labial palp, is connected by conjunctiva distolaterally to the galeo-lacinial complex, proximally to the hypostoma and the cardo and proximolaterally to the mandible.

detailed.name: posterior stipital wall
detailed.def: The area that is limited medially by the medial stipital wall and proximolaterally by the margin of the posterior stipital sclerite.

detailed.name: posterior stipito-palpal muscle
detailed.def: The stipito-palpal muscle that arises medially on the proximal part of the stipes and inserts posteroproximally on the first maxillary palpal segment.

detailed.translation: 后翅下后陷|(后翅下后窝)

detailed.name: posterior supraalar area
detailed.def: The area that is limited medially by the transmetanotal carina and bears the postmedian metanotal wing process.

detailed.name: posterior surface of the glossa
detailed.def: The area of the glossa that is between the distal margin of the prementum and the distal glossal edge.

detailed.name: posterior tentorial arm
detailed.def: The apodeme that extends between the site of origin of the tentorial bridge and the posterior tentorial pit.

detailed.name: posterior tentorial pit
detailed.def: The tentorial pit that corresponds to posterior tentorial arm.

detailed.name: posterior tentorio-scapal muscle
detailed.def: The antennal muscle that arises medially from the proximal parts of the dorsal and anterior tentorial arms and is inserted posteriorly (dorsally) on the proximal part of the scape.

detailed.name: posterior tentorio-stipital muscle
detailed.def: The tentorio-stipital muscle that is posterior to the anterior tentorio-stipital muscle.

detailed.name: posterior thoracic spiracle
detailed.def: The spiracle that is located dorsally on the border between the mesopectus and the metapectus.

detailed.name: posterior tooth of the mandible
detailed.def: The tooth tooth that is located on the posterior surface of the lower tooth.

detailed.name: posterior trochanteral articular process of the mesocoxa
detailed.def: The articular process that is located posteriorly on the distal margin of the mesocoxa bears the posterior trochanteral condyle of the mesocoxa.

detailed.translation: 中足基节后转节关节突
detailed.phonetic: /pɒˈstɪəriə trəʊˈkæntərəl ɑːˈtɪkjʊlər ˈprəʊsɛs ɒv ðə ˈmɛsəʊˈkɒksə/

detailed.name: posterior trochanteral articular process of the metacoxa
detailed.def: The articular process that is located posteriorly on the distal margin of the metacoxa and bears the posterior trochanteral condyle of the metacoxa.

detailed.translation: 后足基节后转节关节突
detailed.phonetic: /pɒˈstɪəriə trəʊˈkæntərəl ɑːˈtɪkjʊlər ˈprəʊsɛs ɒv ðə ˌmɛtəˈkɒksə/

detailed.name: posterior trochanteral articular process of the procoxa
detailed.def: The articular process that is located posteriorly on the distal margin of the procoxa and inserts into the posterior coxal fossa of the protrochanter.

detailed.translation: 前足基节后转节关节突
detailed.phonetic: /pɒˈstɪəriə trəʊˈkæntərəl ɑːˈtɪkjʊlər ˈprəʊsɛs ɒv ðə prəʊˈkɒksə/

detailed.name: posterior trochanteral condyle of the mesocoxa
detailed.def: The condyle that is located on the posterior trochanteral articular process of the mesocoxa and inserts into the posterior coxal fossa of the mesotrochanter.

detailed.name: posterior trochanteral condyle of the metacoxa
detailed.def: The condyle that is located on the posterior trochanteral articular process of the metacoxa and inserts into the posterior coxal fossa of the metatrochanter.

detailed.name: posterior trochanteral condyle of the procoxa
detailed.def: The condyle that is located the posterior trochanteral articular process of the procoxa and inserts into the posterior coxal fossa of the protrochanter.

relationships.target_name: posterior trochanteral articular process of the procoxa

detailed.name: posterodistal notch of the fore wing
detailed.def: The notch on the posterior wing margin that is adjacent to the posterior end of the discal fold.

detailed.name: posterodorsal branch of pronotal Y
detailed.def: The sulcus that connects the transverse pronotal sulcus and the posterior margin of the pronotum ventral to the anterior thoracic spiracle and together with the ventral portion of the transverse pronotal sulcus delimits anteriorly the site of origin of the pronoto-mesobasalar muscle.

detailed.name: posterodorsal edge of pronotum
detailed.def: The edge that is located at the intersection of the dorsal and lateral margins of the pronotum.

detailed.name: posterodorsal edge of the mesopleuron
detailed.def: The edge that is located at the intersection of the mesepimeral ridge and the inflected dorsal margin of the mesopleuron.

detailed.name: posterodorsal metapleural area
detailed.def: The area that is anterior to the metapecto-propodeal conjunctiva, posterior to the metapleural pit and dorsal to the metapleural sulcus.

detailed.name: posterodorsal metapleural sulcus
detailed.def: The groove on the posterodorsal margin of the metapleuron.

detailed.name: posterolateral mesoscutellar area
detailed.def: The area delimited by the posterolateral mesoscutellar carina and the ventral margin of the mesoscutellum

detailed.name: posterolateral mesoscutellar carina
detailed.def: The carina on the posterodorsal mesoscutellum that is dorsally convex.

detailed.name: posterolateral metacoxo-metatrochanteral muscle
detailed.def: The metatrochanteral muscle that arises posteriorly from the coxa and inserts on the articular membrane of the metacoxo-metatrochanteral joint laterally of the posterior metacoxo-metatrochanteral articulation.

synonyms.name: posterior levator of the hind trochanter

detailed.name: posterolateral metapleuro-metanotal muscle
detailed.def: The metapleuro-metanotal muscle that arises posterolaterally from the metapleuron.

detailed.translation: 后侧后胸侧板-后胸背板肌

detailed.name: posterolateral pronotal area
detailed.def: The area that is limited anteriorly by the posterolateral pronotal sulcus.

detailed.name: posterolateral pronotal carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends parallel to the posterolateral margin of the pronotum and delimits the posterolateral margin of pronotum.

detailed.translation: 前胸背板后侧隆线|(前胸背板后侧缘脊)

detailed.name: posterolateral pronotal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that arises from the ventrolateral pit of the pronotum and reaches the posterolateral carina of the pronotum ventral to the anterior thoracic spiracle.

detailed.name: posterolateral tooth-like section of the anterior part of the pronotal plate
detailed.def: The projection that is located submedially on the proximal margin of the pronotal rim.

detailed.translation: (前胸背板前部后侧齿状切面)
detailed.phonetic: /ˌpɒstərəʊˈlætərəl tuːθ laɪk ˈsɛkʃən ɒv ðə ænˈtɪəriə pɑːt ɒv ðə prəˈnəʊtəl pleɪt/

detailed.name: posteromedian process of the mesoscutellum
detailed.def: The median spine that is on the posterodorsal region of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: posteroventral cavity of female T7
detailed.def: The setal pit that is located at the posterior margin of abdominal tergum 8.

detailed.name: posteroventral corner of metapleuron
detailed.def: The corner at the intersection of the ventrolateral and posterior margin of the metapleuron.

detailed.name: posteroventral corner of the first valvifer
detailed.def: The corner of the first valvifer that is adjacent to the intervalvifer articulation.

detailed.name: posteroventral mesal projection of pronotum
detailed.def: The projection at the ventromedian margin of the pronotum.

detailed.name: posteroventral metapleural pit
detailed.def: The pit that corresponds to the dilator muscle apodeme.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板后腹凹|(后胸侧板后腹陷)

detailed.name: postgena
detailed.def: The area that is located on the occiput ventrally of the occipital foramen.

detailed.name: postgenal bridge
detailed.def: The subforaminal bridge that is sclerotised and limited anteriorly (ventrally) by the hypostomal carina and is subdivided medially by the median sulcus of the postgenal bridge.

detailed.name: postgenal cushion
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is located on the postgena.

detailed.name: postgenal groove
detailed.def: The groove that arises from the lateral margin of the postocciput, is curved externally and extends towards the posterior articulation of the mandible.

detailed.name: postgenal lamella
detailed.def: The carina that extends along the lateral margin of the postgenal groove.

detailed.name: postgenal pit
detailed.def: The pit that corresponds to the ventral-most point of the posterior site of fusion of the ventral lamella of the tentorium.

detailed.name: postgenal ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that extends ventrally of the posterior tentorial pit and that is continuous with the tentorium.

detailed.name: postgenal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that corresponds with the postgenal ridge.

detailed.name: postgenal suture
detailed.def: The groove that is median, vertical and extends between the occipital and oral foramina separating the postgenae.

synonyms.name: longitudinal sulci on ventral head sclerotization
median sulcus of the postgenal bridge

detailed.name: postmarginal vein
detailed.def: The abscissa that is marginal and located distal to the marginal vein.

detailed.name: postmedian metanotal wing process
detailed.def: The fossa that is located anteroventrally on the posterior supraalar area and accommodate the posterior condyle of the first axillary sclerite of the hind wing.

detailed.name: postmedian notal wing process
detailed.def: The fossa that is located on the lateral axillar area and articulates with the posterior end of the first axillary sclerite of the fore wing.

detailed.name: postmental area
detailed.def: The area that is limited distally by the posterior margin of the prementum and laterally by the median margins of the cardines and the stipites.

detailed.name: postmental articular zone
detailed.def: The region that corresponds to the distal margin of the intercardinal area.

detailed.name: postmento-premental hinge
detailed.def: The conjunctiva that is between the postmentum and prementum.

detailed.name: postmento-premental muscle
detailed.def: The labial muscle that is unpaired, arises from the postmentum and inserts on the proximal margin of the prementum.

detailed.name: postmentum
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the sclerites that are on the postmental area.

detailed.name: postnotum
detailed.def: The sclerite that bears the phragma and is located posterior to a notum.

detailed.name: postoccipital carina
detailed.def: The rim that surrounds the occipital foramen.

detailed.name: postoccipital muscle
detailed.def: The head muscle that inserts on the postocciput.

detailed.name: postoccipital ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that corresponds to the postoccipital sulcus.

detailed.name: postoccipital sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that is located on the postoccipital suture.

detailed.name: postoccipital suture
detailed.def: The line that delimits the postocciput from the cranium.

detailed.name: postocciput
detailed.def: The area that is delimited by the postoccipital sulcus or postoccipital carina and the occipital foramen and bears the propleural fossa of the cranium.

detailed.name: postocellar carina
detailed.def: The carina that connects the posterior margins of the left and right lateral ocellar fovea.

detailed.translation: (单眼后隆线)|(侧单眼窝后缘间隆线)

detailed.name: postocellar furrow
detailed.def: The sulcus that extends between the posterior margin of the lateral ocelli.

detailed.name: postocular area
detailed.def: The area of the cranium between the dorsal margin of the compound eye and the posterolateral cranial corner.

detailed.name: postocellar vertex
detailed.def: The area posterior to the imaginary line intersecting the lateral ocelli and anterior to the occipital carina.

detailed.name: postocular contour line
detailed.def: The contour line of the postocular area in frontal view.

detailed.name: postocular distance
detailed.def: The median anatomical line of the cranium that is the longest between the dorsal margin of the cranium and the dorsal head width.

detailed.name: postocular head width
detailed.def: The anatomical line between the posteriormost points of the postocular contour lines.

detailed.name: postorbital carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends posteriorly from the genal sulcus.

detailed.translation: 眶后脊|(颊沟后向延伸的脊)

detailed.name: postpalpal ventral premental area
detailed.def: The area that is posterior to the anatomical line connecting the left and right labial palpal excisions.

detailed.name: postpectal carina
detailed.def: The carina that delimits anterolaterally the mesocoxal depression.

synonyms.name: posterior transverse carina of the mesosternum

detailed.translation: (后胸腹板脊)|(中足基节窝前侧缘脊)

detailed.name: postpetiole height
detailed.def: The maximum distance between the dorsal and ventral margin of the postpetiole in lateral view.

detailed.name: postpetiole length
detailed.def: The longest anatomical line that is perpendicular to the posterior margin of the postpetiole in lateral view and is between the posterior postpetiolar margin and the anterior postpetiolar margin.

detailed.name: postpetiole width
detailed.def: The maximum width of the postpetiole in dorsal view.

detailed.name: postphragma
detailed.def: The phragma that is located posteriorly on a thoracic segment.

detailed.name: postscutellum
detailed.def: The area that is located medially on the dorsellum and bears the metanotal flange.

detailed.name: postspiracular furrow
detailed.def: The groove that is longitudinal and is immediately posterior or postero-medial to the first abdominal spiracle.

detailed.name: poststernite
detailed.def: The area corresponding to the postcostal lip of a definitive sternal plate that includes the intersegmental sclerotization following.

detailed.name: posttergite
detailed.def: The area that corresponds to the narrow postcostal lip of a postnotal thoracic plate.

detailed.name: pouch
detailed.def: The area that is located on the conjunctiva and invaginated.

detailed.name: pre-apical ledge
detailed.def: The area that is convave and extends along the distal margin of the scape and is delimited proximally by a carina.

detailed.name: prealare
detailed.comment: There is no prescutal regiaon differenciated in Hymenoptera.

detailed.name: preapical tibial spurs
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the spurs that are proximal to the distal margin of the tibia.

detailed.translation: 胫节近端距|(胫节亚端距)

detailed.name: preapical tooth
detailed.def: The tooth that is located distodorsally on the mandible.

detailed.name: prearticular incisure
detailed.def: The notch that is located on the margin of the second valvifer immediately anterior to the basal articulation of the second valvulae.

detailed.name: prearticular portion of the postmentum
detailed.def: The interstipital sclerite that is connected proximally to the postarticular portion of the postmentum.

detailed.name: preaxilla
detailed.def: The area that is delimited laterally by the parascutal carina, adjacent to the tegula anteriorly and bears the anterior and antemedian mesonotal wing processes.

detailed.name: preaxillar carina
detailed.def: The carina that extends across the preaxilla and separates the articulation area for the tegula.

detailed.name: precoxal carina
detailed.def: The carina that corresponds to the transepisternal line.

detailed.name: precoxal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that corresponds to the transepisternal line.

detailed.name: premental arm
detailed.def: The area of the lateral premental face that receives the site of origin of the dorsal premento-salivarial muscle.

detailed.name: premental carina
detailed.def: The flange that is adjacent to the border between the ventral and lateral premental faces and that overlaps externally the median part of the posterior stipital sclerite.

detailed.name: premental ditch
detailed.def: The scrobe of the prementum that is adjacent to and extends lateral to the premental carina and accommodates the medial part of the posterior stipital sclerite.

detailed.name: premento-glossal muscle
detailed.def: The labial muscle that arises on the ventral part of the prementum, laterally to the ventral premento-salivarial muscle and inserts on the anterior glossal plate.

detailed.name: premento-palpal muscle
detailed.def: The labial muscle that arises from the prementum and inserts on the first sclerite of the labial palp.

detailed.name: prementum
detailed.def: The sclerite that is median, is connected via conjunctiva along its proximolateral margins to the stipites, is articulated with the labial palps, is continuous along its distal margin with the ligula and distolateral margins with the distal hypopharynx and receives the site of attachments of the extrinsic labial palp muscles.

detailed.name: premento-paraglossal muscle
detailed.def: The labial muscle that arises from the ventral part of the prementum, anterior to the origin of the premento-glossal muscle and ventral premento-salivarial muscle and inserts just distally of the distal margin of the prementum.

detailed.name: preoccipital carina
detailed.def: The carina that is transverse and extends posteriorly of the lateral ocelli and compound eye and delimits anteriorly the preoccipital lunula.

detailed.name: preoccipital furrow
detailed.def: The sulcus that arises medially from the anterior margin of the occipital carina and extends towards the anterior ocellus.

detailed.name: preoccipital lunula
detailed.def: The area that is concave, is located on the vertex and is limited anteriorly by the preoccipital carina and posteriorly by the occipital carina.

detailed.name: preocellar pit
detailed.def: The pit that is located on upper face adjacent the anterior margin of the median ocellus and corresponds internally to a conical apodeme and not the tentorium.

detailed.name: preomaular area
detailed.def: The area that is limited posteriorly by the omaulus and ventromedially by the epicnemium.

detailed.name: preoral cavity
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that includes the labrum, hypopharynx and labium.

detailed.name: preorbital carina
detailed.def: The carina that is located on the face, parallels the inner orbit and is paired.

detailed.name: preorbital suture
detailed.def: The sulcus that extends along the median margin of the preorbital trabecula.

detailed.name: preorbital trabecula
detailed.def: The bar that extends along the inner orbit and terminates dorsally at the juncture of the transverse trabecula and supraorbital trabecula.

detailed.name: prepalpal ventral premental area
detailed.def: The area that is anterior to the anatomical line connecting the left and right labial palpal excisions.

detailed.name: prepectal carina
detailed.def: The carina that divides the prepectus for the vertical lateral portion and the horizontal, ventral prepectal shelf.

detailed.translation: (前胸腹侧区隆线)|(前胸侧腹板脊)

detailed.name: prepectal shelf
detailed.def: The area that is horizontal and located ventrally on the prepectus.

detailed.name: prepecto-anterior thoracic spiracle muscle
detailed.def: The anterior thoracic spiracle occlusor muscle that originates from the prepectus and inserts on the mesothoracic spiracle.

detailed.name: prepecto-mesobasalar muscle
detailed.def: The mesobasalar muscle that arises from the prepectus.

detailed.name: prepecto-procoxal muscle
detailed.def: The procoxal muscle that arises from the prepectus.

detailed.name: prepectus
detailed.def: The intersegmentalia that is located on the mesopectus-pronotum intersegmental membrane and corresponds to the site of origin of the anterior thoracic spiracle occlusor muscle.

detailed.name: prescutal ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that seperates the prescutum from scutum.

detailed.name: prescutal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that sets off the prescutum from the scutum and corresponds to the prescutal ridge.

detailed.name: prescutum
detailed.def: The area that is located on the alinotum and is limited by the antecostal suture and prescutal suture.

detailed.name: prespecular sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that delimits anteriorly the speculum and corresponds to the anterior margin of the speculum.

detailed.name: prespiracular carina
detailed.def: The carina that delimits the spiracular furrow medially.

detailed.name: presternum
detailed.def: The area that is located on the basisternum and is delimited by the sternacostal sulcus.

detailed.name: prespiracular propodeal area
detailed.def: The area that is located between the first metasomal spiracle and metapleural arm and delimited laterally by the metapleural carina.

detailed.name: prestigma
detailed.def: The patch that is enlarged, sclerotized, and located at the apex of one or more wing veins on the anterior margin of the wing.

detailed.name: pretarsus
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is apical to the telotarsus and composed of the empodium, auxilia, planta, pulvillum, unguis, unguitractor plate, auxiliar sclerite and manubrium.

detailed.name: pretarsus of mesotarsus
detailed.def: The pretarsus that is located on the mesotarsus.

detailed.translation: 中足跗端节|中足前跗节

detailed.name: pretarsus of metatarsus
detailed.def: The pretarsus that is located in the metatasrus.

detailed.name: pretarsus of protarsus
detailed.def: The pretarsus that is located in the protarsus.

detailed.translation: 前跗端跗节|(前足端跗节)

detailed.name: primary gonopore
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is the transition from the ductus ejaculatorius to the endophallus and therefore the transition from the internal to the external male genitalia.

detailed.translation: 初生生殖孔|(初级生殖孔)

detailed.name: principal carina of stipes
detailed.def: The flange that extends along the margin of the posterior stipital wall.

detailed.name: probasicoxite
detailed.def: The basicoxite that is located on the procoxa.

detailed.name: probasisternum
detailed.def: The basisternum that is located in the propectus.

detailed.name: probasitarsus
detailed.def: The basitarsus that is located on the protarsus.

detailed.name: proboscidial fossa
detailed.def: The scrobe that is located medially on the hypostoma and accommodates the proboscis.

detailed.name: process
detailed.def: The area on the sclerite that is raised.

detailed.name: processus articularis
detailed.def: The process that extends laterally from the proximal part of the second valvula and forms the median part of the basal articulation, and corresponds to the site of attachment for the anterior second valvifer-second valvula muscle.

relationships.target_name: dorsal ramus of the second valvula

detailed.name: processus musculares
detailed.def: The apodeme that extends dorsally from the proximal part of the second valvula to the genital membrane and receives  the site of attachment of the posterior second valvifer-second valvula muscle.

detailed.name: procoxa
detailed.def: The coxa that is located on the fore leg.

detailed.name: procoxal foramen
detailed.def: The coxal foramen that is located on the propectus.

detailed.name: procoxal muscle
detailed.def: The leg muscle that inserts on the procoxa.

detailed.name: procoxo-protrochanteral joint
detailed.def: The dicondylic joint that is composed of the procoxa, the protrochanter and the articular membrane of the procoxo-protrochanteral joint.

detailed.name: proctiger
detailed.def: The area that is located arond the anal opening posterior to the epipygium and hypopygium.

detailed.name: procuticle
detailed.def: The cuticle that containes chitin fibrils and is located between the Schmidt's layer and the epicuticle.

detailed.name: prodiscrimen
detailed.def: The discrimen that is located in the prothorax and corresponds to the prodiscrimenal lamella.

detailed.name: prodiscrimenal lamella
detailed.def: The discrimenal lamella that is located in the prothorax.

detailed.name: profemoral scrobe of the mesopectus
detailed.def: The scrobe that is on the mesopectus and accommodates the profemur.

detailed.name: profemoro-pretarsus of protarsus muscle
detailed.def: The flexor of the pretarsal claws of the fore leg muscle that arises from the profemur.

is_a.name: flexor of the pretarsal claws of the fore leg

detailed.translation: 前足股节-前足跗节端跗节肌肉|(前股-前跗端跗肌)

detailed.name: profemoro-protibial joint
detailed.def: The femoro-tibial joint that is composed of the profemur, protibia and the articular membrane of the profemoro-protibial joint.

detailed.name: profemur
detailed.def: The femur that is located on the fore leg.

detailed.name: profurca
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the profurcal arms.

detailed.name: profurcal arm
detailed.def: The sternal apophysis that is paired, arises from the furcasternum of the prothorax and continuous with the prodiscrimenal lamella.

detailed.name: profurcal bridge
detailed.def: The area that connects distally the lateral profurcal arms.

detailed.name: profurcal muscle
detailed.def: The thoracic muscle that inserts on the profurca.

detailed.name: profurcal pit
detailed.def: The furcal pit that is located in the prothorax.

detailed.name: profurcasternum
detailed.def: The furcasternum that is located in the prothorax.

detailed.name: profurco-laterocervical muscle
detailed.def: The laterocervical muscle that arises medially from the anterior surface of the dorsal profurcal lamella.

detailed.name: profurco-postoccipital muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that arises from the profurca and inserts on the postocciput.

detailed.name: profurco-procoxal muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that arises from the profurca and inserts on the procoxa.

detailed.name: profurco-prophragmal muscle
detailed.def: The prophragmal muscle that arises from the profurca.

detailed.name: profurco-protrochanteral muscle
detailed.def: The protrochanteral muscle that arises from the profurca and inserts on the protrochanteral apodeme.

detailed.name: projection
detailed.def: The process that is located on an edge.

detailed.name: prong of hypopygium
detailed.def: The projection that is located submedially on the distal margin of the hypopygium.

detailed.name: pronope
detailed.def: The depression that is dorsomedian and is located on the pronotum.

detailed.name: pronotal cervical sulcus
detailed.comment: The class is equivalent with the transverse pronotal sulcus.

detailed.translation: 前胸颈沟|(前胸背板颈沟)

detailed.name: pronotal collar
detailed.def: The area of the pronotum that is subhorizontal and located posteriorly of the pronotal neck.

detailed.translation: 前胸背板领|(前胸背板颈后亚水平区)

detailed.name: pronotal condyle of the mesoscutum
detailed.def: The submedial condyle that is located on the ventral margin of the mesoscutum and inserts into the mesonotal fossa of the pronotum.

detailed.translation: 中胸盾片前背髁|(中胸盾片前背突)
