detailed.def: The unguitractor plate that is located in the mesotarsus.

detailed.name: unguitractor plate of the metatarsus
detailed.def: The unguitractor plate that is located in the metatarsus.

detailed.translation: 后跗节掣爪片|(后跗节掣爪板)

detailed.name: unguitractor plate of the protarsus
detailed.def: The unguitractor plate that is located on the protarsus.

detailed.name: unilaminar epithelium
detailed.def: Epithelium that consists of a single layer of epithelial cells.

detailed.name: uniporous sensillum
detailed.def: The sensillum whose cuticular component has one cuticular pore.

detailed.name: upper face
detailed.def: The area that is located dorsally of the ventral margin of the antennal rim and ventrally of the anterior ocellus medial to the inner margins of the eye and malar line.

detailed.name: upper mesepisternum
detailed.def: The area that corresponds to the site of origin of the mesopleuro-mesobasalar, second and third mesopleuro-third axillary sclerite of fore wing and second mesopleuro-mesonotal muscles.

detailed.translation: 中胸前侧片上区|(中胸侧板上部)

detailed.name: upper mesopleural rim
detailed.def: The carina that traverses the subdorsal mesopleuron.

detailed.name: upper ocular sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that is limited medially by the intersection of the frontofacial sulcus and the scrobal sulcus.

detailed.name: vagina
detailed.def: The distalmost region of the female genital duct.

detailed.name: valvar ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that is vertical and extends along the valviceps.

detailed.name: valviceps
detailed.def: The area that is the distal part of the penisvalva dorsally of the ergot.

detailed.name: valvillus
detailed.def: The sclerite that articulates on the first valvula and projects into the egg/poison canal.

detailed.name: valvispina
detailed.def: The spine that is located on the paravalva.

detailed.name: valvura
detailed.def: The area that is located proximally of the ergot on the penisvalva.

detailed.name: vannal region
detailed.def: The area that is delimited by the vannal veins, or veins that articulates with the third axillary sclerite.

detailed.name: vas deferens
detailed.def: The duct that connect the testis with the ejaculatory duct.

detailed.name: velum
detailed.def: The area that is lamella-like and is located on the calcar.

detailed.name: venom gland
detailed.def: The accessory gland that is not paired and that empties into the female reproductive duct and that is of class I gland.

detailed.name: venom gland reservoir of the second valvifer
detailed.def: The gland reservoir that is between the second valvifers.

detailed.phonetic: /ˈvɛnəm ɡlænd ˈrɛzəvwɑːr ʌv ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈvælvɪfər/

detailed.name: venter
detailed.def: The area that is located between the left and right coxal foramina.

detailed.name: ventral T9-second valvifer muscle
detailed.def: The ovipositor muscle that arises from the lateral region of female T9 and inserts along the posterior part of the dorsal flange of the second valvifer.

synonyms.name: Posterior tergal muscle of the 2nd valvifer

detailed.translation: 腹侧第9背板-第二负瓣片肌

detailed.name: ventral apodeme of the first phragma
detailed.def: The apodeme that is located anterolaterally on the prophragma and corresponds to the site of origin of the third mesopleuro-mesonotal muscle.

detailed.name: ventral bridge of the pronotum
detailed.def: The area that connects ventrally the left and right halves of the pronotum.

detailed.name: ventral carina of the metapleuron
detailed.def: The carina that is located on the border of the metepisternal depression and the metacoxal depression.

detailed.translation: 后胸侧板腹侧隆线|(后胸侧板腹脊)

detailed.name: ventral cibarial dilatator
detailed.def: The hypopharyngeal muscle that is unpaired and arises from the median anterior part of the tentorial bridge and inserts on the proximal part of the ventral wall of the cibarium or on the proximal margin of the sitophore, immediately distally to the point where the alimentary canal passes between the lateral arms of the sitophore.

detailed.name: ventral clypeal margin
detailed.def: The margin that delimits the clypeus distally (ventrally or anteriorly depending on the orientation of the head).

detailed.name: ventral dististipital process
detailed.def: The projection that is located distally on the posterior stipital sclerite and encircles the base of the maxillary palp.

detailed.name: ventral edge of propleuron
detailed.def: The edge that sets off the ventral vertical lobe of the propleuron from the ventral propleural area.

detailed.name: ventral glossal lines
detailed.def: The carinae that radiates from the posterior glossal plate towards the apical glossal setae.

detailed.name: ventral gonostyle/volsella complex-penisvalval muscle
detailed.def: The penisvalval muscle that arises ventrally from the gonostyle/volsella complex.

detailed.translation: 生殖基柱/阳基腹铁复合体-阳基瓣腹向肌肉

detailed.name: ventral head line
detailed.def: The anatomical line between the anteriormost (ventralmost) points of compound eyes in frontal view.

detailed.name: ventral head width
detailed.def: The anatomical line between the intersections of the cranium contour and ventral head line in frontal view. dorsal head width

detailed.name: ventral impressed area of metanotum
detailed.def: The area that is median and is delimited anteriorly by the metascutellar arms and the metascutelum.

detailed.name: ventral invagination of the metapleural carina
detailed.def: The invagination that is at the ventral end of the of the metapleural carina.

detailed.name: ventral keel of petiole
detailed.def: The carina that is median and extends ventrally along the petiole.

detailed.translation: 腹柄腹中脊|(腹柄腹侧隆线)

detailed.name: ventral lamella of the tentorium
detailed.def: The ridge that extends ventrally on the posterior part of the tentorial arm.

detailed.name: ventral lock of the femoro-tibial joint
detailed.def: The lock between a sclerite that is on or continuous with the tibial flexor tendon and the ventral femoral wall.

detailed.phonetic: /ˈvɛntrəl lɒk ɒv ðə ˈfɛmərəʊ ˈtɪbiəl dʒɔɪnt/

detailed.name: ventral margin of the mesopectus
detailed.def: The median anatomical line that extends between the acetabular carina and the medial coxal articulations.

detailed.name: ventral margin of the metapectus
detailed.def: The median anatomical line that extends between the anterior margin of the ventral region of the metapectus and the distal end of the projection bearing the medial coxal condyle of the metapectus.

detailed.name: ventral mesofurco-profurcal muscle
detailed.def: The profurcal muscle that arises from the mesofurcal bridge and inserts proximally of the profurca.

detailed.translation: 中胸叉骨-前胸叉骨腹向肌肉

detailed.name: ventral mesopostnotal flange
detailed.def: The area that is more heavily sclerotised than surrounding areas, traverse the mesopostnotum, unites laterally with the dorsal mesopostnotal flange, continuous laterally with the laterophragma and ventrally (posteriorly) with the mesophragma.

detailed.name: ventral mesotibio-mesobasitarsal muscle
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises ventrally from the mesotibia and inserts ventrally on the articular membrane of the mesotibio-mesobasitarsal joint.

detailed.translation: 中足胫节-基跗节腹侧肌肉

detailed.name: ventral metafurcal lamella
detailed.def: The ridge that is located ventrally on the metafurcal arm.

detailed.name: ventral metapleural area
detailed.def: The area that is located on the metapleuron anteroventrally of the metapleural sulcus.

detailed.name: ventral metapleuro-third axillary sclerite of hind wing muscle
detailed.def: The metapleuro-third axillary sclerite of hind wing muscle that arises ventrolaterally from the metapectus.

synonyms.name: ventral metapleuro-third axillary sclerite of hind wing

is_a.name: metapleuro-third axillary sclerite of hind wing muscle

relationships.target_name: third axillary sclerite of the hind wing

detailed.name: ventral metatibio-metabasitarsal muscle
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises anteriorly from the tibia and inserts ventrally on the proximal margin of the metabasitarsus.

detailed.translation: 后胫-后基跗节腹向肌肉

detailed.name: ventral pharyngeal dilatator
detailed.def: The pharyngeal muscle that arises from the dorsal surface of the tentorial bridge and inserts ventrally on the pharyngeal wall.

detailed.name: ventral plaque
detailed.def: The carina that is located ventrally on the scape and sensory in function.

detailed.name: ventral premental face
detailed.def: The area of the prementum that is delimited laterally by the lateral premental face.

detailed.name: ventral profurcal lamella
detailed.def: The ridge that is located ventrally on the profurcal arm and corresponds to the site of origin of the profurco-procoxal muscle.

detailed.name: ventral profurco-postoccipital muscle
detailed.def: The postoccipital muscle that arises partly from the anterior surface of the dorsal profurcal lamella ventral to the site of origin of the dorsal profurco-postoccipital muscle and partly from the median area of the dorsal profurcal lamella.

detailed.name: ventral pronotal pit
detailed.def: The pit that is located ventrally on the pronotum.

detailed.translation: 前胸背板腹凹|(前胸背板腹侧陷窝)

detailed.name: ventral pronoto-mesopectal articulation
detailed.def: The articulation between the posteroventral mesal projection of the pronotum and the pronotal fossa of the mesopectus.

detailed.translation: (前胸背板-中胸腹板腹侧关节)

detailed.name: ventral pronoto-procoxal muscle
detailed.def: The pronoto-procoxal muscle that originates anteroventrally from the pronotum and inserts posterolaterally on the procoxa.

detailed.name: ventral propleural area
detailed.def: The area that is located ventrally on the propleuron and is delimited laterally by the longitudinal carina of the propleuron.

detailed.name: ventral propodeal carina
detailed.def: The carina that separates the metasomal depression from the metacoxal depression.

detailed.name: ventral protibio-probasitarsal muscle
detailed.def: The intrinsic leg muscle that arises ventrally from the protibia and inserts ventrally on the articular membrane of the protibio-probasitarsal joint.

detailed.name: ventral ridge of clypeus
detailed.def: The ridge that arises medially from the pleurostomal condyle and corresponds to the site of attachment of the labrum.

detailed.name: ventral rim of clypeus
detailed.def: The rim that extends along the distal margin of the clypeus.

detailed.name: ventral rod of aedeagus
detailed.def: The apodeme that arises distoventrally from the aedeagus and is continuous with the ventromedian conjunctiva of the gonostyle/volsella complex.

detailed.name: ventral row of spines
detailed.def: The row that is composed of spines and is located ventrally on the apex of the calcar.

detailed.name: ventral ramus of the second valvula
detailed.def: The area of the second valvifer-second vavula-third valvifer complex that bears the rhachis.

detailed.name: ventral salivarial dilatator
detailed.def: The salivarial muscle that arises from the proximal end of the ventral part of the prementum and inserts on the salivarial sclerite.

detailed.name: ventral sclerite of the first valvifer
detailed.def: The sclerite of the first valvifer that is ventral to the transvalviferal conjunctiva.

detailed.name: ventral spine of hypopygium
detailed.def: The area that is median and projecting posteriorly.

detailed.name: ventral vertical lobe of the propleuron
detailed.def: The area that is limited dorsally (anteriorly) by the ventral edge of the propleuron.

detailed.name: ventral wall of the second valvulae
detailed.def: The ventral, usually weakly sclerotized region of the second valvulae, that is medially continuous with the rachises.

detailed.name: ventrolateral basiglossal arm
detailed.def: The projection that is located proximolaterally on the anterior glossal plate and articulates with the basiparaglossal sclerite.

detailed.name: ventrolateral cupolo-gonostyle/volsella complex
detailed.def: The cupulo-gonostyle/volsella complex muscle that inserts ventrolaterally on the gonostyle/volsella complex between the site of insertion of the ventromedial and dorsolateral cupulo-gonostyle/volsella complex muscles.

detailed.name: ventrolateral invagination of the pronotum
detailed.def: The invagination that at the ventrolateral edge of the pronotum.

detailed.name: ventrolateral setiferous patch
detailed.def: The sublateral setiferous patch that is on the frons between the intertorular carina and the facial pit, and is separated from the median setiferous patch by the supraclypeal depression.

detailed.name: ventromedial cupulo-gonostyle/volsella complex muscle
detailed.def: The cupulo-gonostyle/volsella complex muscle that inserts medially on the ventral region of the gonostyle/volsella complex.

detailed.name: ventromedian apodeme of the aedeagus
detailed.def: The apodeme that arises distoventrally from the aedeagus and is not continuous with the ventromedian conjunctiva of the gonostyle/volsella complex.

detailed.name: ventromedian setiferous patch
detailed.def: The median setiferous patch that is on the frons between the intertorular carina and the facial pit.

detailed.name: verricule
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is composed of closely gathered setae.

detailed.name: vertex
detailed.def: The area that is delimited by the intersection of the margin of the compound eyes, the interorbital plane, and the anatomical line that is tangential to the point on the margin of the anterior ocellus which defines the minimum distance between the anterior ocellus and the oral foramen.

detailed.name: vertex patch
detailed.def: The setiferous patch that is located on the vertex.

detailed.name: vertexal sulcus
detailed.def: The sulcus that is horizontal and extends between the compound eye and the lateral ocellus.

detailed.name: vertical apodemal lobe of the mesoscutellum
detailed.def: The inflection that extends along the posterolateral margin of the mesoscutellum and articulates with the dorsal propodeal inflection.

detailed.name: vertical epomia
detailed.def: The carina that is the vertical section of the epomial carina that begins ventrally and terminates at the junction of the transverse pronotal carina and the lateral epomia.

detailed.name: vertical lobe of mesoscutum
detailed.def: The inflection that extends ventrally along the anterolateral margin of the mesoscutum.

detailed.name: vertical ocellar sulcus
detailed.def: The frontal line that is a sulcus.

detailed.name: vesicula seminalis
detailed.def: The anatomical space that functions as storage of spermatozoa.

detailed.name: vestibulum
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is located dorsally of abdominal sternum 7 when the latter extends beyond the abdominal sternum 8.

detailed.name: villus
detailed.def: The area that is covered with dense setae and is located posterior to the metapleural spiracle.

detailed.name: visceral muscle
detailed.def: The muscle that is attached to the alimentary canal.

detailed.name: volsella
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the sclerites on the ventral part of the male genitalia that are not connected to the cupula via muscles.

detailed.name: volsellar plate
detailed.def: The area that is located on the parossiculus ventromedially of the cuspis.

detailed.name: volsellar ridge
detailed.def: The ridge that is located on the parossiculus, originates from the gonossiculo-parossicular articulation and extends towards the proximal margin of the parossiculus.

detailed.name: vulva
detailed.def: The anatomical space that corresponds to the opening of the vagina.

detailed.name: width
detailed.def: A 1-D extent quality which is equal to the distance from one side of an object to another side which is opposite.

detailed.name: width of 1st flagellomere
detailed.def: The width of the 1st flagellomere.

detailed.name: width of mesoscutellar-axillar complex
detailed.def: The maximum width of the mesoscutellar-axillar complex in dorsal view.

detailed.translation: (中胸小盾片-腋片复合体宽度)

detailed.name: width of pedicel
detailed.def: The maximum width of the pedicel.

detailed.name: window under lateral bar
detailed.def: The anatomical space that is encircled by the lateral bar of the mesoscutellum.

detailed.name: wing
detailed.def: The appendage that is between the notum and the pectus and is connected to the body by the axillary sclerite muscles.

detailed.name: wing base
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of the pteralia, humeral complex, tegula and axillary cord.

detailed.name: wing blade
detailed.def: The area that is located distally of the wing base.

detailed.name: wing cell
detailed.def: The wing membrane that is delimited by wing veins.

detailed.name: wing crease
detailed.def: The line along which the wing is creased.

detailed.name: wing membrane
detailed.def: The area that is not vein and not sclerotised.

detailed.name: wing region
detailed.def: The area that is delimited by flexion and fold lines on the wing.

detailed.name: wing vein
detailed.def: The area that is linear and sclerotised and acts as support for the wing membrane.

detailed.name: wing venation
detailed.def: The anatomical cluster that is composed of abscissae.

detailed.name: propleural arm-procoxal muscle
detailed.def: The procoxal muscle that originates from the propleural arm.

detailed.translation: 前胸侧板臂-前足基节肌

detailed.name: prospinasternal apodeme
detailed.def: The apodeme on the anteroventral margin of the mesopectus that serves as the site of origin of prospinasternal muscles.
